| |

# [Hell no.](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=193502696&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkzNTAyNjk2LCJpYXQiOjE3NzU3Nzk1NzYsImV4cCI6MTc3ODM3MTU3NiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.WgN1H2xucBz0flCt9w4ehE96UyN4JxoRrA01zVZqjBc)
### We cannot let Donald Trump rig his way to a majority.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Apr 10
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9vcGVuLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9wdWIvaGFsZXlmb3JtaS9wL2hlbGwtbm8_.7-hWKQEjkSk2cLcKKCz2JC88fF860lwJ1VnNwjLlWWc?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/hell-no?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Friends,
When I saw the news about Donald Trump's latest executive order attacking vote-by-mail, the first thought that came to my head was _HELL no._
This is just the latest of MAGA Republicans' attacks on our freedom to vote. We saw it with the attempt to overturn the 2020 election, and most recently, the SAVE America Act.
It's yet another blatant attempt to rig the system so they can keep imposing Trump's chaotic, unpopular agenda on the American people.
**Well, folks, not if people like you and I have anything to say about it.**
Our right to vote is the core of what our democracy is all about. Heck, without it, we wouldn't even HAVE a democracy.
We can't let two-and-a-half centuries of democracy die at the hands of a man who thinks he's above the law.
This executive order is wrong and it's dangerous, but my promise to you is that I will never stop fighting for your right to vote - including your right to vote by mail. For disabled people, elderly folks, students, military service members, and so many more, vote-by-mail is the **ONLY** way to make sure their vote is counted.
In Michigan, we take our right to vote seriously. In 2024, hundreds of thousands of Michiganders chose to vote by mail. That's something to be proud of, friends.
Our leaders should be focused on making it _easier_ to vote. So why are Donald Trump and the GOP trying to make it harder for Americans to vote?
**It 's because they are scared of us.** They know voting is power, and their grip on it is slipping, so they'll do whatever they can - including cheating and violating the constitution - to keep their majority.
**[But we need leaders with grit and integrity, who will defend our fundamental rights, not strip them away.](https://substack.com/redirect/59604b8c-4357-4af5-b397-2d0517a9f9bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
I know that if I can't win your vote fair and square, then I don't deserve it. That's why I'll fight every day to make sure I do, because that's the kind of leader our state needs.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/59604b8c-4357-4af5-b397-2d0517a9f9bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

body:
Something big just happened in NH...
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102660?refcode=em20260409-10288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10288%2E614464%2EarIgvD)
Peter, it’s Governor JB Pritzker.
I’m emailing you today about New Hampshire’s Senate race because this is serious: **Senate Republicans’ hand-picked candidate, John Sununu, jumped in to defeat Chris Pappas and flip this open Senate seat red.**
**[Before I go any further, I have to ask: Will you split $15 or more between Chris Pappas and State Democrats Committee to keep New Hampshire blue?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102660?refcode=em20260409-10288&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10288%2E614464%2EarIgvD)**
_Without Chris Pappas winning in New Hampshire, Democrats won’t have a chance at taking back a majority in the Senate._ That’s why this race is being targeted by GOP super PACs and Republicans across the country.
The NRSC — which pours millions into electing Republicans to the Senate — said they’re “all-in” on John Sununu. And polling shows: This race is a _statistical dead heat_ between Chris Pappas and John Sununu.

**If we don’t act FAST, we could lose these critical networks for good!**

[**Public broadcasters need to know we have their backs! So we’re gathering 10,000 signatures by MIDNIGHT to stay in the fight and show our solidarity »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/106433?t=7&akid=23561%2E878179%2ETRJOB6) | [**Chip in $3 to sign now »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/106433?t=8&akid=23561%2E878179%2ETRJOB6)

FROM: A grateful Democrat
Subject: Thank you! To all public broadcasters,

Thank you. Thank you for enriching all of our lives — in rural and urban areas, and everywhere in between — with your various news and educational programs.

I couldn’t be more THRILLED to see Trump’s disgusting executive order blocked. _His authoritarian power grab didn’t stand a chance against our fight._

**But until your funding is resumed, I won’t stop fighting. I also know that his attempts to SILENCE the free press won’t end here.**

[**In case you missed it we just launched a $20,000 Super Saturday fund. Can you chip in to help us reach our goal?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260409_2.MdZ0aS&=20260409-481&t=2&akid=481%2E12592%2EZqUGor)

This Saturday tells you everything you need to know about this election. On the YES Campaign side, our volunteers are preparing to be out in the streets across Virginia talking to voters, knocking doors, and doing the hard work to win.
On the other side, Speaker Mike Johnson is headlining a major fundraiser to bring in huge checks from Donald Trump’s donors. Peter Thiel is funding racist mailers comparing redistricting in Virginia to Jim Crow. And MAGA dark money groups are sending texts that lie about Gov. Spanberger’s support of the YES campaign.
**We’re fighting for people. They’re fighting for power.**
What happens in these final days could determine who wins. That’s why Super Saturday matters so much. It’s our chance to reach thousands of voters directly and cut through the noise.
In just a few days, hundreds of people from all walks of life are heading out to talk to their neighbors about this referendum and the importance of voting YES. Before we can do that we need supplies for training these volunteers like clipboards, literature, and gas.
[**Will you donate $3 right now to help us buy the supplies we need before Super Saturday and help us reach our $20,000 goal?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260409_2.MdZ0aS&amount=3&refcode=20260409-481&t=22&akid=481%2E12592%2EZqUGor)

name: The Liberty Ledger
subject: Trump lashes out at crumbling NATO alliance following 'frank' closed-door meeting
body:
President Donald Trump continues to bash NATO after meeting behind closed doors with Secretary-General Mark Rutte, further signaling that the alliance could be crumbling. Trump has long been critical of NATO, claiming that allies routinely fail to pull their own weight. This sentiment has reached a fever pitch since NATO allies have refused to aid the United States during the war with Iran. As a result, Trump told these allies to fend for themselves during the energy crisis, and he has not backed down. 'This was a very frank, very open discussion.'Trump has openly floated the idea of withdrawing from the alliance altogether after having a "frank and open" discussion with Rutte in the White House on Wednesday. | [](http://trk.libertyledger._ZD01In0/BO4XdbC_shaQTbrEO3J9wg)

| | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE************** Contact: info@bofrench.com April 10, 2026 **Bo French Announces Legislative Priority: Adding Muslim Countries to China Land Ban**
FORT WORTH, TX - On Friday, Bo French announced that his first legislative priority as Railroad Commissioner will be the expansion of Senate Bill 17 to include Muslim-majority countries.
Senate Bill 17, also referred to as the “China Land Ban” bill, prohibited the sale of Texas land to noncitizens from China, Russia, Iran, and North Korea because of their threat to state security. Governor Abbott enthusiastically signed Senate Bill 17 when it was passed by the Texas Legislature during the 89th session.
Announcing this legislative priority, Bo French issued the following statement:
“Islam poses an existential threat to Texans’ way of life. While Iran is currently included in the SB 17 prohibition, several other muslim countries are allowed to purchase land in Texas, which they use to influence the Texas Oil and Gas Industry. As Railroad Commissioner, I look forward to working with the Texas Legislature to include all muslim-majority countries under SB17 and enforcing it as your next Railroad Commissioner.”
Currently, several Muslim-majority countries other than Iran own land and operate pipelines, refineries, and drilling operations on Texas soil.
French continued, saying:
“I’m running for Railroad Commissioner to put Texans back in the driver's seat of Texas energy policy. America has been at war with Islam since the time of our Independence, and stopping the subversive influence of Islam in Texas by banning all Muslim countries from acquiring land and interfering in Texas Oil and Gas will be my top legislative priority.”
###

## Colorado State Releases Hurricane Forecast
Colorado State University (CSU) [released](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2S6yAMRp8Gd3gA47-C4jbuctstPTLIgVlsMqDEydvvOLO7L7CNCkmjo_N9XOYLhBj263_Y0NBzTfOOR4lIhHn295yDhR3XlNFCIUqvRGBxVkJ1XGguxewgxNesK2cW4UZZoZF93w5yGMeu8qZpGyV67dS66s4NMNi-WVBotHIYhwarYM5jQkshpWikrGUn136RC7QOW-E00wJdoJRr8kj4hLLGV3pgrm3aqmg80a2w5h9TE1PTcRy1jcF-Kp_uhdJ-bp19BPKYmZpOHFOT0GcZmZpsufOMEaFg4YEKf9v9yvMfe-4xY-GHB-KB-Iawl3PIv0lMTVU27naEGEPpeqbFdYMQ33_S39J9GPUVAAD__wV3jyY) its annual Atlantic hurricane forecast yesterday, predicting slightly below-average activity with 13 named storms, six hurricanes, and two major hurricanes (Category 3 or higher). The historical average is 14 named storms, seven hurricanes, and three major hurricanes. Warmer-than-average sea surface temperatures--a factor contributing to hurricane development and strength--are negated in part by the shift to an El Niño weather pattern, resulting in higher wind shear. In fact, meteorologists [are forecasting](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uqzAQhJ_GdCCvMX-Fi9vQ5banRAusgyVjI3sTwtsfkVc49Yzm03w_j-mBzrvw_I87Gf7YOAU6sydmStP2SsktGMjGRAtm5nhFxoUmJVVbSl2CnFZ0_pp0sZpZrgMUZKDrmh76YWiLzczDMtvaWqjtjDVC02ndSWV7XROAHQpn7jGpQQLIGqCCFmw3w4zNSo1ctdCSVscxVbwR0wez9Vd8U6qWuBfebMxHFvU_oUahxvM8q_3KGDBwDC7eJaHG-9WdEvJGSagRE7vFk1Bjfh2USvJlcCGWX0CpFAxN3fXVsR1FMutxOu9dbjuh5XNH579s_puxt1G_AQAA__8TjoD3) that a "Super El Niño" could develop this summer and persist through the end of the year. ## Summer Camps Sue over Fiber Optic Requirement
A coalition of 19 Texas summer camps is [suing the state](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkD3OpDAQRE9jMo_cxtgQEGxC9m26IWpMM1hrbGT3_HD71cwVNiyVqvT0_vzMPxhiSPffeNDI7y3PiV41EjOVeX-UEjwm2nIhj5U5X5nR06yVtlIZCWpeMcRrNs06LmodoKERnOt66IfBNvu4eNuj0ot12rXGd26wnRk6tw5ua63xTRg_Z8qAAlAtwA0sbG6BBbuVOrUaYRStgXO58U5Mb6xbvPKTys3no4njznxW0f4SehJ6wsVD-2mEns5cWejpu5H1cRxUpMfj_ASSS8z-r0z0kiExlUQsyyOSrHiFdJe8F0KmVCUuIQa-ZD6pIJPQE_S9BTAg9NSUcT1fIcZQrRNG3Q8M8UvG_-fzOep_AQAA___WEorg) to block a new law requiring the installation of "end-to-end fiber optic facilities" in order to operate this summer. State lawmakers established the requirement in response to the deadly flash floods that killed 27 campers and counselors at Camp Mystic last summer. After first responders struggled to communicate with staff at Camp Mystic during the disaster, a law was passed requiring overnight camps to have fiber-optic and broadband internet connections. The lawsuit argues that the requirement is unreasonable, cost-prohibitive, and could [force them to close down](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LuO5CAQheGnsbNqAb4SEGzibDbd0CpDMUaLwYLqcfvtVz3R5hMf6dPR_-dj_cAQQ_r8jQcZfvm8JrpqJGYq6_4sJVhM5HMhi5U535nR0qqEGkH0IMXqMMR77VtnNuG0bMnIaRpmOWs9trvBedCjHDvbbaITat6cRms7P_tO6WnWbTBvTPRSSCk6KR9ylH7a5IaDo0G4vukFucC5PHgnphdWH-_8ReVh89FGszOftel-NWpp1HJd1-PvC9N7bNQSkqOTkqNkCRze4GPOrjZqkRq-MbB4nBXqk6AyMsGbBh82KpBPDhZCYiqJGMozUoVwnLmSA_RMBRyhi_-xbTHuvEKMoY5T04vPA0P8fso_6_tl1L8AAAD__xyQkwI). Hello, I hope the spring is off to a great start for you and yours.
As you probably know, I run a wireless company, Noble Mobile, that pays people to use their phones less. It's clicked with people in part because we are all struggling with our relationship with our phones, what Hasan Minhaj calls our 'rectangles of sadness.' Noble today has thousands of subscribers and millions of annual revenue - thank you if you've been an early adopter!
How bad is your screen time? Well I'm proud to announce that starting today, you can find out! Introducing the Brain Rot Index (BRI), now in the free Noble Life app.
Your BRI is a daily score that tracks your phone pickups, screen time, and social media usage -- and tells you exactly how rotted your brain is getting. If you've wondered how good or bad your phone use is, this is for you. For fun, if your score is in the acceptable range you can earn up to $100, plus 5.5% annual growth on your balance, on Noble.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0142fead-0a47-4370-b382-851cfdc0a626?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Getting started takes about 60 seconds:
1\. [Download the Noble Life app](https://substack.com/redirect/9d0d2d27-1e80-471e-acb7-fa0e922206b9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
2\. Create your free account
3\. Track your Brain Rot Index daily
I founded Noble because millions of Americans are overpaying for wireless and losing hours of our lives to our phones. The hidden tax comes to over $100 billion a year and much more when you factor in our time and attention. This is a way to put money and time back in people's pockets right now.
What's my Brain Rot Index? Let's just say that you will probably do better than I do. :)
Look Up.

- Andrew

He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | Escalation with Iran is rattling global markets, putting energy, finance, and major corporations under pressure. Patriot,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I've always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven't received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That's why I'm proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you'll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)

Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let's show these patriots they're not forgotten.

_**If we don 't fight for our fellow patriots now, who will?**_

When you donate to Stand in the Gap, you're not just defending individuals. _You are defending the soul of our country_.

**As long as there 's breath in my lungs and truth in my heart, I'll be singing to honor veterans and first responders. I hope you'll join me by taking action right now.**

subject: I don't usually send messages like this, but the situation is critical.
body:
We are on the brink of losing everything we’ve fought for.

---
| | | | | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zh2abr1dfv8noohtl8ivemvtbt97u2urfdcveke8_rp22sh2s8i6epr5c3gm0or3cjh2bs)
---
| | | | | I don't usually send messages like this, but the situation is critical.

It's Trump-endorsed MAGA Patriot Byron Donalds, and I need you to read every word, because Democrats are trying to shut me up.

We are on the brink of losing everything we've fought for. The Democrats are launching an all-out assault on the MAGA Movement, and time is running out.

My race has become the _**[MOST TARGETED](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2d6vam8u1rvuivlvv42doer105pij6228cv7imo_rp22sh2s8i6epr5c3gm0or3cjh2bs "MOST TARGETED")**_ race in the nation, because Democrats know if they take Florida from us, there's nothing they can't take.

As President Trump's STRONGEST ally, I'm working around the clock to defend our values, protect our freedoms, and preserve the future of this country.

But Democrats aren't slowing down--**they 're escalating.**

They're building a massive war chest worth millions to defeat me and silence voices like yours. They're using every tactic possible to dismantle President Trump's agenda and DESTROY MAGA

The last time I spoke with President Trump, he left me with three words:

**KEEP MAGA STRONG.**

I can't let him down, and if we don't make a response right here, the MAGA movement will be stopped in its tracks, and SEVERE consequences will follow.

We cannot let that happen.

That's why I'm reaching out to you right now with urgency.

I know how much you've done, and I hate asking again, but if I'm being honest:

**We have to be unified, right now.**

So I'm asking: Can I ask you to chip in ANY AMOUNT to support my race?
---
| | [STAND WITH MAGA](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zvf2hbjpqfcrsu1atlesdouuujogss6j5e0u17pg_rp22sh2s8i6epr5c3gm0or3cjh2bs)
---

If MAGA falls short in Florida, the media will waste no time declaring our movement finished.

And once that happens, I fear we'll be at the point of no return.

Please, this was hard to write, but I can't stress this enough: This is **URGENT.**

With you by my side, we'll restore momentum, not just here in Florida, but **EVERYWHERE.**

Together, we will keep the momentum alive and secure victory for President Trump, YOU, and all of MAGA.

---

God bless,

Byron

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129159562/613495996/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkOTRmMmEwLWRlMzQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=F6wBLGamX2CrCP25FRpWe1NHIEdIpwOWNKK6H5QGtog=&emci=289b4de9-5634-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=8d94f2a0-de34-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=8431045)

Here’s some good news: it looks like the anti-voter SAVE America Act won’t get past the Senate, at least not yet. That’s a sigh of relief. **But, Peter, we can’t relax, not even for a second — Republicans are now floating increasingly desperate ways to pass the most egregious parts of this legislation. ** From the start, the fight against the SAVE Act has felt like playing a game of Whac-a-Mole — they don’t have the votes to pass it, but President Trump and his MAGA allies keep trying new schemes to force it through. **The NDRC is essential to defeating this anti-voter legislation. [Make a gift to sustain our movement’s lasting opposition to the SAVE Act and the increasing attacks on representative democracy.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129159564/613496014/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_WhacAMole_email_20260410-NDRC-Tier1-WhacAMole_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260410-NDRC-Tier1-WhacAMole_&utm_campaign=WhacAMole&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkOTRmMmEwLWRlMzQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=F6wBLGamX2CrCP25FRpWe1NHIEdIpwOWNKK6H5QGtog=)** The latest idea from Trump and anti-democracy forces is to skirt Senate rules by lumping some of the worst anti-voter provisions of the SAVE Act into a budget bill that can’t be stopped by a filibuster. Meanwhile, the administration has a new executive order trying to rein in mail-in voting, while dangerous anti-voter bills (mini SAVE Acts) are popping up on the state level across the country. Just in the last several weeks, lawmakers in Florida, South Dakota, and Utah have passed legislation that impose new, extreme hurdles to prove your citizenship to gain access to the ballot. And states like Louisiana, Wyoming, and New Hampshire have similar laws already on the books. **Let’s be clear: Any iteration of the SAVE Act would be detrimental to election access and could silence millions of voters.[Help fight back against the rise in anti-democracy policies — wherever they raise their ugly heads.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129159566/613496016/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_WhacAMole_email_20260410-NDRC-Tier1-WhacAMole_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260410-NDRC-Tier1-WhacAMole_&utm_campaign=WhacAMole&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkOTRmMmEwLWRlMzQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=F6wBLGamX2CrCP25FRpWe1NHIEdIpwOWNKK6H5QGtog=)** Thank you for strengthening our response, National Democratic Redistricting Committee | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129159581/613496018/359562654?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_WhacAMole_email_20260410-NDRC-Tier1-WhacAMole_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20260410-NDRC-Tier1-WhacAMole_&utm_campaign=WhacAMole&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjhkOTRmMmEwLWRlMzQtZjExMS04ZWYyLTAwMGQzYTE0YjY0MCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=F6wBLGamX2CrCP25FRpWe1NHIEdIpwOWNKK6H5QGtog=)

##### APRIL 10, 2026 | DERELICTIONS DOSSIER | VOLUME 2
## **I. The Lie**
In July 2025, Daniel Webster told Florida families:
**" I am introducing legislation to dramatically reform FEMA."**
He promised transparency, an end to hidden costs, and the resolution of a broken system. Promises betrayed by his own record.
## **II. The Duty**
A representative's first duty is to protect their constituents. Not to study them from a distance, but to stand with them. Not to manage the consequences of their suffering, but to stop the theft before it begins.
For fifteen years, that duty was ignored.
This dossier is a bill of indictment. It follows the money and exposes the paper trail of betrayal.
* * *
## **III. The Proof: 15 Years of Record**
#### **2012: The Creation**
Webster voted **YEA** on **H.R. 4348** , embedding the **Biggert-Waters Act** into law.
* **The Impact:** This created the "actuarial soundness" mandate that removed subsidies and birthed Risk Rating 2.0.

#### **2014: The Patch**
Webster voted **YEA** on **H.R. 3370**.
* **The Impact:** It capped rate increases at 18% but left the Black Box mechanism intact.

#### **2020: The Absence**
Webster **DID NOT VOTE** on **H.R. 133**.
* **The Impact:** He was absent for the final vote to fund FEMA in FY2021--the year the agency implemented Risk Rating 2.0, forcing millions of Americans into a new, opaque pricing system without any congressional oversight or reform.

#### **2022 & 2024: The Failed Stops**
Webster voted **NAY** on **H.R. 2471** and **H.R. 2872**.
* **The Impact:** The bills passed anyway. The Black Box continued operating.

#### **2026: The Contradiction**
Webster voted **YEA** on **H.R. 7148**.
* **The Impact:** Less than a year after promising to "dramatically reform FEMA," he voted to fully fund the program, thereby playing a critical role in the National Flood Insurance Fund's continued operation of the Risk Rating 2.0 algorithm.

* * *
## **IV. The Verdict**
**The Promise:** "Dramatically Reform FEMA."
**The Action:** 15 Years of Constructing, Guaranteeing, and Betraying
**The Math:**
* **15 Years of Complicity.**
* **2 Votes to Construct The Black Box.**
* **2 Votes to Guarantee Its Durability.**
* **1 Non-Vote to Empower Its Rollout.**
* **1 Vote to Distract and Betray.**
* **0 Reforms Introduced.**

Daniel Webster did not reform FEMA. He managed its consequences while ensuring its survival.
**The voter 's choice is clear:**
**A Derelict Sentry:** Hiding costs. Abandoning oversight. Betraying trust.
**Striking the Root:** Forcing transparency. Mandating votes. Securing Florida families.
**We choose to strike the root.**
* * *
## **V. Evidence Appendix**
**The record is public. The sources are primary. For those who wish to verify the facts presented in this Dossier, the raw links are provided below.**
**THE CREATION (2012)**
* **Bill:** H.R. 4348 (Moving Ahead for Progress in the 21st Century Act / MAP-21)
* **What It Did:** Embedded the Biggert-Waters Flood Insurance Reform Act of 2012 as Division F, Title II, creating the "actuarial soundness" mandate.
* **Webster 's Vote:** YEA (Roll Call #523)
* **Public Law:** 112-141
* **Sources:**
* Congress.gov Bill Page: https://www.congress.gov/bill/112th-congress/house-bill/4348
* Vote Record: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2012451
* Official PDF (See Division F): https://www.congress.gov/112/plaws/publ141/PLAW-112publ141.pdf

* * *
**THE PATCH (2014)**
* **Bill:** H.R. 3370 (Homeowner Flood Insurance Affordability Act of 2014)
* **What It Did:** Capped annual rate increases at 18% but did not repeal the actuarial mandate.
* **Webster 's Vote:** YEA (Roll Call #15)
* **Public Law:** 113-89
* **Sources:**
* Congress.gov Bill Page: https://www.congress.gov/bill/113th-congress/house-bill/3370
* Vote Record: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/201491
* Official Text: https://www.congress.gov/bill/113th-congress/house-bill/3370/text/statute

* * *
**THE ABSENCE (2021)**
* **Bill:** H.R. 133 (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2021)
* **What It Did:** Funded the NFIP for FY2021, including $263 million for "Flood Hazard Mapping and Risk Analysis" (the Black Box infrastructure). Explicitly preserved the Biggert-Waters Act with no reform language.
* **Webster 's Vote:** NOT VOTING (Roll Call #251)
* **Public Law:** 116-260
* **Sources:**
* **Sources:**
* Congress.gov Bill Page: https://www.congress.gov/bill/116th-congress/house-bill/133
* Clerk Vote Record: https://clerk.house.gov/Votes/2020251
* Official Text (GovInfo): https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/PLAW-116publ260/html/PLAW-116publ260.htm

* * *
**THE FAILED STOPS (2022 & 2024)**
* **Bill 1:** H.R. 2471 (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2022)
* **What It Did:** Continued funding for FEMA and the NFIP. The bill passed despite Webster's Nay vote.
* **Webster 's Vote:** NAY (Roll Call #68)
* **Public Law:** 117-103
* **Sources:**
* Congress.gov Bill Page: https://www.congress.gov/bill/117th-congress/house-bill/2471
* Clerk Vote Record: https://www.congress.gov/votes/house/117-2/68
* **Bill 2:** H.R. 2872 (Further Additional Continuing Appropriations Act, 2024)
* **What It Did:** A Continuing Resolution that funded all agencies, including FEMA, through March 2024. The bill passed despite Webster's Nay vote.
* **Webster 's Vote:** NAY (Roll Call #15)
* **Public Law:** 118-35
* **Sources:**
* Congress.gov Bill Page: https://www.congress.gov/bill/118th-congress/house-bill/2872
* Clerk Vote Record: https://www.congress.gov/votes/house/118-2/15

* * *
**THE CONTRADICTION (2026)**
* **Bill:** H.R. 7148 (Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2026)
* **What It Did:** The current funding bill for FEMA and the NFIP, ensuring the continued operation of Risk Rating 2.0. This vote followed his 2025 promise to "dramatically reform FEMA."
* **Webster 's Vote:** YEA
* **Public Law:** 119-29
* **Sources:**
* Congress.gov Bill Page: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/7148
* Clerk Vote Record: https://www.congress.gov/votes/house/119-2/53
* Official PDF: https://www.congress.gov/119/bills/hr7148/BILLS-119hr7148enr.pdf

* * *
**THE CLAIM (July 2025)**
* **Source:** Daniel Webster's Campaign Website News Release
* **What It Said:** Webster introduces legislation to dramatically reform FEMA.
* **Web Page:** https://www.electwebster.com/news

[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

Patriot,

I recently came across a striking statistic.

**72% of J6 defendants were military veterans or first responders.**

And while courts often consider prior service as a factor for lighter sentences, the prosecutors and judges in these cases used their veteran or first responder status to argue for _**harsher penalties**_.

_Is this how our criminal justice system thanks them for their service?_

I’ve always honored those who serve. We are living the American dream _because_ of them. The way these patriots were treated is a grave injustice.

And while President Trump has pardoned almost all of the J6 defendants, they still haven’t received justice.

The lives and reputations of these patriots remain shattered from the lost years to the consistent government and mainstream media smear campaign they endured.

That’s why I’m proud to support Stand in the Gap.

This remarkable organization provides real, practical help, like rent money, job training, transportation, legal referrals, trauma counseling, and health insurance, to help these persecuted patriots move on with their lives.

[If you believe in liberty, in due process, and in standing up for our fellow Americans, I hope you’ll make a donation to Stand in the Gap today. >>](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
[Donate](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
Before January 6th, many of these patriots were unaware of just how broken the American justice system truly was.
Even after being pardoned, many J6 defendants still face...
* Difficulties finding a job
* Loss of rights, like the right to vote or the right to own a firearm
* Harassment on social media and in their personal lives
* Strained family relationships due to lost time in prison
* And even homelessness.

For many, returning to some semblance of a normal life is overwhelming.

**Stand in the Gap is committed to being a comprehensive support system for J6 defendants and their families by providing essential resources to help these American patriots heal physically, mentally, emotionally, and spiritually.**

Stand in the Gap believes in second chances, providing support to individuals transitioning back into society after incarceration, and working towards a more forward-thinking and restorative prison system that sends non-violent offenders into the world better off than they were when they went in.

Through their programs, partnerships, and advocacy efforts, they are making a lasting impact on the lives of those in need.

**There are nearly 1,600 Americans who are looking for a second chance.**

Let’s show these patriots they’re not forgotten.

[Will you help J6 defendants get back on their feet by donating $10, $35, $50, or even $100 to Stand in the Gap today? >>](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
[Donate $10](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate $35](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate $50](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate $100](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate $1,000](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

[Donate Any Amount](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
This isn’t about politics. It’s about justice.

These are real Americans — veterans, first responders, fathers, mothers, hard-working citizens — who exercised their First Amendment rights and were persecuted for their political beliefs.

_**If we don’t fight for our fellow patriots now, who will?**_

When you donate to Stand in the Gap, you’re not just defending individuals. _You are defending the soul of our country_.

**As long as there’s breath in my lungs and truth in my heart, I’ll be singing to honor veterans and first responders. I hope you’ll join me by taking action right now.**
[Donate](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)
For faith, freedom, and country,

John Rich

What Trump said was not normal. It was not “just rhetoric.” It was cruel, reckless, and chilling. When a president talks casually about mass death, we should all be alarmed. When he uses language like that, we should not look away. And when he counts on people getting numb to it, we have to prove him wrong. = = Because here’s the truth: Trump wants people to feel powerless. He wants us overwhelmed, exhausted, and numb. He wants us to believe this is just how politics works now. But I don’t buy that for a second and neither should you. I believe outrage is only useful if we do something with it. I believe courage is contagious. And I believe the only way to meet dangerous, cruel politics is with clarity, conviction, and a whole lot of backbone. So no, I’m not staying silent. When a president sounds this unwell and speaks this casually about devastation and war, the answer cannot be to shrug and move on. We have to call it out and we have to push back. Trump says something horrifying, people gasp, and then too many politicians move on like it’s business as usual. I’m not about to let that become normal. I’ll keep calling this what it is: dangerous, deranged, and totally unacceptable. = This movement is powered by people who still give a damn. People who haven’t given up. People who know that empathy is not weakness, that speaking plainly matters, and that this country is worth fighting for. That’s you. And I’m so grateful you’re with me. body:
Have you ever heard of a drug lord named Juan Orlando Hernández?
# [](https://act.electjon.com/go/4589?t=1&akid=2052%2E5691347%2E2WdFk1)

Peter —
Have you ever heard of a drug lord named Juan Orlando Hernández?
[](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260410-1-full&t=2&akid=2052%2E5691347%2E2WdFk1)
It’s a wild story ... because he used to be the President of Honduras.
A couple of years ago, a federal judge here in the United States sentenced him to _45 years_ for conspiring to traffic hundreds of tons of cocaine into the United States. He had taken millions from the Sinaloa Cartel and used the Honduran army and police to help them run drugs to America.
And then Donald Trump PARDONED him.
Just stop and think about it ... Donald Trump _pardoned a man who helped the cartels make billions of dollars trafficking vast amounts of cocaine into the United States._
Trump freed **a notorious international narcotrafficker.** Why? Because he was Trump’s political ally ... and because he sent a four-page letter to Trump saying Trump was a better president than Biden.
Meanwhile, the First Family is raking in billions of dollars from foreign interests and foreign governments. Never in the history of corruption has so little effort gone into hiding so much graft.
Never have presidential abuses of power been so obscene.
But here’s the thing: We have the power to deliver a landslide rebuke of these abuses that will echo down through history.
And we have the power to reform the broken and corrupt political system that gave rise to Trump in the first place.
But none of this is possible without VICTORY in November. And the battle is on.
I’m the only Democratic Senator up for reelection in a state Trump won. That makes Georgia MAGA’s top pickup opportunity in the Senate this year.
So if you’re sick of the chaos and corruption ... if you’re outraged by what’s happening in this country — please chip in so I can keep this U.S. Senate seat out of MAGA’s hands:
**Here's the link to donate:[https://act.electjon.com/go/Donate](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260410-1-full&t=3&akid=2052%2E5691347%2E2WdFk1)**
Every day our wave grows taller and our tent grows bigger. All across Georgia, more and more people of every background are outraged by this administration.
The people are fed up.
Look at Texas. Look at Virginia. Look at New Jersey.
Look at Minneapolis, where they organized to protect children from being kidnapped at school, where tens of thousands marched in protest, where non-violent civil disobedience forced the tyrant to retreat.
Come November, the people who have been looting this country and desecrating our values are going to be held accountable.
They know it. They fear it. And that’s why their abuses are becoming more reckless and more desperate.
But as long as we don’t give in to doubt or despair or division, our victories will be so decisive that no half baked plot hatched in the White House will foil the will of the people.
[**So I’m asking you to join this team, donate $5, and help us win in Georgia this November. You can chip in here:**](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260410-1-full&amount=5&t=4&akid=2052%2E5691347%2E2WdFk1)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.electjon.com/go/32?c0=ossoff-em-april26.1MDdBw&refcode=em260410-1-full&amount=5&t=5&akid=2052%2E5691347%2E2WdFk1)**
Thanks for being part of this team.
Jon Ossoff

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Thank you for supporting Jon Ossoff. Email is a critical way to keep up with Jon and his work in the US Senate, but you can click [here](https://act.electjon.com/signup/fewer-emails-signup/?t=6&akid=2052%2E5691347%2E2WdFk1) to sign up to receive fewer emails, or click [here](https://act.electjon.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=7&akid=2052%2E5691347%2E2WdFk1) if you'd like to unsubscribe.

subject: How does healthcare impact you? Share your thoughts! 🚑 💊 💉
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Tell us your thoughts on healthcare!
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20doctor%20and%20patient.jpg]
Texans – you still have time! We’re winding down our healthcare survey collection, so have your voice heard by taking it today [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform] !
We’ve all seen how health insurance premiums have increased in the past year, and how Trump and MAGA have targeted Medicaid and Medicare.
Tell us what REAL healthcare looks like to you, your personal health story, and how you would improve the system!
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform]
TOP community health listening session in San Antonio next week
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Galveston%202025%20Day%203%20group%20pic.jpg]
Join TOP and fellow San Antonio community members for a FREE dinner and to share your personal healthcare experience at our next listening session on April 16 from 6 - 8 p.m. at our TOP office , as we explore local and statewide solutions to our broken healthcare system.
Click here for more details and to reserve your spot. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gzGoh4-16UmwwnBkS-Co7w2]
Contact Damaris N. at dneaves@organizetexas.org [dneaves@organizetexas.org] for more information on this dinner and how you can plug in to our Bexar County healthcare justice organizing.
Voter reg. deadline for primary runoffs is approaching
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Texas%20voter%20registration%20card.jpg]
If you or someone you know wasn't registered to vote for March's primary election and wanted to vote, they still have time to register to participate in May's primary runoffs.
Texas law requires eligible voters to register by the 30th day before Election Day. The voter reg. deadline for the May 26 Primary Runoff Election is April 27 .
Start the registration process here. [https://www.texas.gov/living-in-texas/texas-voter-registration/]
TRUMP TRACKER:
He's undermining our elections because he's scared of us voting
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Mail%20in%20ballot.png]
Speaking of elections, we’re applying Critical Ignoring [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] to close out our Trump Tracker series, as we continue combating MAGA's "flood the zone" [https://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] strategy. This week, we're looking at the many ways in which POTUS is trying to tip the scales in his favor this midterm.
Erratic as ever, Trump knows he’s cooked if voters across the country turn out in BIG numbers to the polls this November.
Just as he’s waged war against Iran, he’s waged war against voting rights and our electoral processes here at home since returning to power.
Keep in mind this war against our elections didn’t happen overnight. Trump 2.0 has been steadily chipping away at policies intended to safeguard voting rights, all so that he can have more authority to control election outcomes.
Check out this informative timeline from Brennan Center For Justice. [https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/timeline-trump-administrations-efforts-undermine-elections]
One of his latest executive orders [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/04/06/trumps-mail-in-ballot-eo-explained/89439380007/] seeks to seize control of states' mail voting rules and restrict mail-in voting, showing how seriously we have to take this coming midterm election (and don't forget the ridiculous and dangerous SAVE Act [https://www.naacpldf.org/case-issue/save-act-saves-no-one-voter-suppression-bill-explained/] ).
As we get closer to the midterms, and as his approval numbers continue to plummet, we can expect Trump to continue to propose outlandish voting restrictions. [https://www.project-syndicate.org/commentary/how-trump-could-attempt-coup-before-midterm-elections-by-timothy-snyder-2026-04] No matter the obstacles, we the people will still show up strong this fall to vote against his damaging and embarrassing presidency.
Español
Compartan sus opininiones sobre la atención médica
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Black%20doctor%20and%20patient.jpg]
¡Todavía tienen tiempo! Estamos terminando nuestra colección de encuestas de atención médica, ¡así que haz que tu voz sea escuchada haciéndola hoy! [http://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform]
Todos hemos visto cómo las primas del seguro de salud han aumentado en el último año, y cómo Trump y MAGA han puesto en riesgo Medicaid y Medicare.
Queremos saber cómo es para usted una atención médica REAL . Comparta su historia y sus ideas para transformar el sistema de salud.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform]
Sesión comunitaria de escucha sobre salud de TOP en San Antonio la próxima semana
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Galveston%202025%20Day%203%20group%20pic.jpg]
Únase a TOP y a otros miembros de la comunidad de San Antonio para disfrutar de una cena GRATUITA y comparte tu experiencia personal con el cuidado de la salud en nuestra próxima sesión de escucha el 16 de abril de 6 a 8 p.m. en nuestra oficina de TOP , mientras exploramos soluciones locales y estatales para nuestro sistema de salud que no está funcionando.fracturado.
Haga clic aquí para obtener más detalles y reservar su lugar. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/gzGoh4-16UmwwnBkS-Co7w2]
Comuníquese con Damaris N. en dneaves@organizetexas.org [dneaves@organizetexas.org] para recibir más información sobre esta cena y sobre cómo puede involucrarse en nuestras iniciativas de organización por la justicia en salud en el condado de Bexar.
Se acerca la fecha límite para registrarse para votar en la segunda vuelta electoral
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Smaller%20-%20Texas%20voter%20registration%20card.jpg]
Si usted o alguien que conoce no se registró para votar en las elecciones primarias de marzo y quería votar, todavía tiene tiempo para registrarse y participar en las elecciones primarias de segunda vuelta en mayo.
La ley de Texas requiere que los votantes elegibles se registren 30 días antes del Día de la Elección. La fecha límite para registrarse para votar en la Elección Primaria de Segunda Vuelta del 26 de mayo es el 27 de abril.
Inicie el proceso de registro aquí. [https://www.texas.gov/living-in-texas/texas-voter-registration/]
RASTREADOR DE TRUMP:
Él está socavando nuestras elecciones porque tiene miedo de que votemos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Mail%20in%20ballot.png]
Hablando de elecciones, estamos aplicando el Ignorar Críticamente [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] para cerrar nuestra serie Trump Tracker , mientras seguimos combatiendo la estrategia de Inundar La Zona [https://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] del movimiento MAGA. Esta semana, analizamos las múltiples formas en que el presidente intenta inclinar la balanza a su favor en estas elecciones de mitad de mandato
Tan impredecible como siempre, Trump sabe que está en problemas si los votantes de todo el país salen a votar en GRANDES números este noviembre.
Así como ha emprendido una guerra contra Irán, también ha emprendido una guerra contra el derecho al voto y nuestros procesos electorales aquí en casa desde que regresó al poder.
Ten en cuenta que este ataque contra nuestras elecciones no ocurrió de la noche a la mañana. Trump 2.0 ha estado debilitando poco a poco políticas diseñadas para proteger el derecho al voto, con el objetivo de tener más control sobre los resultados electorales.
Echen un vistazo a esta cronología informativa del Brennan Center for Justice. [https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports/timeline-trump-administrations-efforts-undermine-elections]
Una de sus órdenes ejecutivas más recientes [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2026/04/06/trumps-mail-in-ballot-eo-explained/89439380007/] busca tomar control de las reglas estatales sobre la votación por correo y restringir el voto por correo, lo que demuestra lo seriamente que debemos tomar esta próxima elección de medio término (y no olvidemos la ridícula y peligrosa Ley SAVE) [https://www.naacpldf.org/case-issue/save-act-saves-no-one-voter-suppression-bill-explained/] .
A medida que nos acercamos a las elecciones de medio término, y mientras sus niveles de aprobación continúan cayendo, podemos esperar que Trump siga proponiendo restricciones de voto fuera de lugar. [https://www.project-syndicate.org/commentary/how-trump-could-attempt-coup-before-midterm-elections-by-timothy-snyder-2026-04] Sin importar los obstáculos, el pueblo se presentará con fuerza este otoño para votar en contra de su presidencia dañina y vergonzosa.

Peter, I need to be honest with you about something.

Standing on principle in Washington means making tough calls. When a spending bill comes to the floor, I read every page. I ask the hard questions. And if it adds to the debt or wastes taxpayer money, I vote no.

**That's what I was elected to do in the Senate.**

The national debt is $39 trillion and climbing. We're paying $1.22 trillion a year just on interest payments. The Congressional Budget Office says we will add $23.9 trillion in debt over the next decade.

I introduced the Six Penny Plan to balance the budget in five years. I've exposed $1.6 trillion in government waste through my Festivus Reports. I force debates on spending when others want to fast-track bills without scrutiny.

**And I will keep saying no to reckless spending.**

I came to the Senate to fight for the Constitution, defend liberty, and protect your hard-earned money from being wasted by bureaucrats and special interests.

That means doing my homework on every bill. That means forcing accountability when no one else will. That means voting my conscience even when the easy path is to vote yes.

**But I cannot do it alone.**

If we are going to break Washington's addiction to spending, it takes grassroots Americans standing up and demanding better.

body:

Everything costs more right now. Gas. Groceries. Your electric bill.
That’s not an accident.
It’s the direct result of Trump’s reckless, unauthorized war with Iran.
After launching the war without Congress, Iran shut down the Strait of Hormuz, which is a key global oil route. Oil prices surged. And when oil goes up, everything goes up.
You feel it every day at the pump, at the store, and in your monthly bills.
And Rob Wittman? Silent.
I’m Mel Tull, and I’m running for Congress because working families shouldn’t pay the price for reckless wars.
Congress must have a say before we send our country into conflict. Period.
If elected, I’ll fight to ensure no president drags us into war without congressional approval.
Chip in $25, $50, or $100 right now. Let's flip VA-01 and send leaders to Congress who will fight for affordability, not endless wars. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/melltull4congress]

name: Tabitha Isner
subject: From the Capitol to the Community
body:
A quick update on the legislative session, civic engagement, and the fights that matter most.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a1f2cf2cf489/im-running-for-alabamas-most-flippable-state-senate-seat-in-15-years-13693633?e=62156fa6a8)
---
[|
---](https://tabithaisner.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=800028f57ad91543dbbdd90f2&id=66cf48156a&e=62156fa6a8)
|
---
| | | | | |
# Update from the Legislature:
# Fighting for Beau’s Law and
# Fair Utility Rates
---
|
---
| | As this legislative session wraps up, I’m reminded that Alabama families are still being asked to carry too much while the people in power too often focus on the wrong things. We saw plenty of bad bills and political distractions this year, but one issue that hit close to home for so many families was the cost of keeping the lights on. Utility rates and the Public Service Commission may not always make the front page, but they affect our monthly bills in a very real way. [And now, as more attention is finally being paid to who controls those decisions, it’s clear Alabama needs more transparency, more accountability, and leaders willing to stand up for everyday people — not just protect the status quo](https://tabithaisner.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=800028f57ad91543dbbdd90f2&id=67f2416652&e=62156fa6a8).
At the same time, I was proud to support Beau’s Law alongside fellow Montgomery legislator Phillip Ensler. In a session that often felt frustrating, Beau’s Law was a reminder that good, bipartisan legislation is still possible. It’s a commonsense, humane measure to protect dogs from neglect and abuse, and I was glad to see it move forward. Alabama deserves more of that kind of leadership — practical, compassionate, and focused on doing what’s right.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| |
---
|
---
| |
# Updates from the Field:
# Campaign in Full Swing
---
|
---
| | On March 28, I was proud to speak at Montgomery’s No Kings rally at the Alabama State Capitol, where more than a thousand people gathered to stand up for democracy and push back against the dangerous idea that power belongs to one person instead of the people. The energy was strong, the message was clear, and it was encouraging to see so many Alabamians show up ready to speak out, stand together, and be heard.
What made that day even more powerful is that Montgomery was part of something much bigger. The March 28 No Kings protests were part of a nationwide day of action that reached all 50 states and countries abroad. Organizers estimate that at least 8 million people took part in more than 3,300 events worldwide, making it one of the largest protest mobilizations in modern history. That kind of turnout matters. It sends a message that people across this country are ready to stand up for democracy, dignity, and the freedoms we refuse to lose.
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | I was glad to join the Rollin to the Polls candidate forum in Montgomery this April for Senate Districts 25 and 26. Rollin to the Polls does important work to help people become informed, engaged voters, and spaces like that matter because democracy works best when people have the chance to hear directly from those asking for their vote.
My opponent did not show up. I did — because I believe showing up matters. If you want to represent this community, you should be willing to be in the room, answer questions, and take part in conversations that strengthen civic engagement. That is the kind of leadership I believe this state and district deserve.
---
| | | | | | | | | | | [Donate to Keep Team Tabitha Rollin’!](https://tabithaisner.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=800028f57ad91543dbbdd90f2&id=622cb676f7&e=62156fa6a8)
---
|
---
| |
# Protecting Contraception and IVF Access
---
|
---
| | In March, [I joined Rep. Marilyn Lands and other advocates for a roundtable](https://tabithaisner.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=800028f57ad91543dbbdd90f2&id=f3b20a0197&e=62156fa6a8) on the importance of protecting access to contraception and IVF. These are not abstract political issues — they are real healthcare decisions that affect Alabama women, families, and their ability to plan their futures with dignity and certainty.
That is why [I also recently wrote an op-ed](https://tabithaisner.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=800028f57ad91543dbbdd90f2&id=2f8304159a&e=62156fa6a8) calling on Alabama lawmakers to act now to protect the right to contraception and IVF. I believe these decisions should stay with families and their doctors, not politicians, and I will keep speaking out for the basic freedoms and healthcare protections Alabama families deserve.
---
|
---
| |
# Tabitha on National Stage
---
|
---
| | This week, I am proud to represent Alabama at the Democratic National Committee’s Spring 2026 meeting in New Orleans. As First Vice Chair of the Alabama Democratic Party and a DNC member, I’m working to make sure Alabama has a voice in the national conversations shaping the future of our party.
Whether it’s through my leadership with the Alabama Democratic Party or my civic engagement work with Atlas for Democracy, I believe Alabama belongs at the table. I’ll keep showing up, speaking up, and fighting to make sure our state is part of building what comes next.
---
|

| Letter from the Chair
---
A Message from the Heartland: Why Rural Nebraska Matters
I highly recommend that every urban Republican periodically visit our more rural counties. What you'll discover there is a refreshing reminder of what makes America great: kindness, patriotism, enthusiasm, cooperation, generosity, and an unshakeable commitment to our shared values.
At least, that's what you find when our Party is led by men and women who genuinely reflect those same qualities.
Last night, I attended the Buffalo County Republican Convention. I mostly listened--and spoke only briefly--but I left deeply encouraged, grateful, and filled with pride in the hardworking people who form the bedrock of our nation and the backbone of our Party.
Every person in that room sacrificed precious hours of their time to be there. Volunteers were recognized for their tireless efforts organizing decorations, credentialing, the silent auction, registration, and countless other details. Officeholders, military veterans, and first responders received well-deserved applause. Candidates and their representatives were given a respectful forum to share their vision for the future.
Rural America serves as the great bulkhead in the cultural battles facing our country today. Those of us living in Nebraska's urban eastern corridor can too easily get distracted by the endless pettiness and partisan squabbling. We sometimes lose sight of what this fight is truly about: the preservation of our traditions, our constitutional freedoms, and the American way of life.
The men and women I visited with in Buffalo County are not taking their way of life for granted. They clearly understand that the values and communities they cherish are under threat from multiple directions. Yet rather than despair, these cheerful warriors are stepping up--donating their time, treasure, and talent to defend all that they hold dear.
None of us can afford to sit on the sidelines. We cannot assume someone else will do the work, write the checks, or provide the leadership. We have watched too many of our institutions--government, education, the media, and even some churches--crumble under the weight of self-serving egoists and pernicious corruption.
Now is the time to rally. Let us preserve what is good, true, and beautiful in our republic. Let us courageously let go of what no longer serves us--or what actively undermines us and the principles that made this country exceptional.
The heartland is awake. The foundation is strong. Let's join these rural patriots and recommit ourselves to the cultural and political war for our country.

For Nebraska, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

We sometimes lose sight of what this fight is truly about: the preservation of our traditions, our constitutional freedoms, and the American way of life. The men and women I visited with in Buffalo County are not taking their way of life for granted. They clearly understand that the values and communities they cherish are under threat from multiple directions. Yet rather than despair, these cheerful warriors are stepping up--donating their time, treasure, and talent to defend all that they hold dear. None of us can afford to sit on the sidelines. We cannot assume someone else will do the work, write the checks, or provide the leadership. We have watched too many of our institutions--government, education, the media, and even some churches--crumble under the weight of self-serving egoists and pernicious corruption. Now is the time to rally. Let us preserve what is good, true, and beautiful in our republic. Let us courageously let go of what no longer serves us--or what actively undermines us and the principles that made this country exceptional. The heartland is awake. The foundation is strong. Let's join these rural patriots and recommit ourselves to the cultural and political war for our country. name: Deb Haaland
subject: Sharing my story
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
[photos enclosed]

| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/134?t=1&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
---
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=2&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
Friend, I grew up in a military family, so we moved around a lot. But no matter where we lived, we were always outdoors, running through the desert with my cousins, fishing with my dad, or walking the cornfields with my grandfather. Back then, I never imagined that those moments would shape my path, **[let alone lead me to run for governor of New Mexico.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=3&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=4&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
From my great-grandmother, mother, and many before them, I’m blessed to come from generations of Pueblo women who taught me what it means to be fierce and resilient — and I’ve carried these values with me my entire life.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=5&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
My parents didn’t graduate from college, but they believed deeply in giving back and helping others. They taught me that where you come from matters and that service is about showing up for people. It’s why I tell kids not to forget their roots and why I believe everyone, no matter their background, has something to offer their community.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=6&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
I carried those values when I started working at my local bakery right after high school; when I volunteered at my child’s preschool to help reduce the cost of tuition; and when I started my own small business producing and canning homemade salsa.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=7&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
I carried them with me when I was a single mom living paycheck to paycheck, relying on food stamps and WIC to help keep my child fed and healthy.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=8&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
And I carried those values with me as one of the first Native American women elected to Congress and then as the first Native Secretary of the Interior.

**To this day, those values of ferocity and resilience _[fuel my fight to advocate for working families and deliver progress for all New Mexicans.](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=9&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)_**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=10&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
But here’s the thing: **The governor’s seat has a history of switching parties every eight years, and GOP donors are already preparing to spend millions to defeat me. If we're going to buck the trend, I need you on my grassroots team, friend.**
**_[So please, will you contribute $5 or more today to help me become our next governor and create a better future for all New Mexicans?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=11&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)_**
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/7306?refcode=jtk555-fr-nd&amount=5&t=12&akid=8855%2E400544%2E8cKbLV)
---
Be fierce,

Deb

body:

**Peter - Trump is trying to kill mail-in voting in California.**

Last week, he signed an executive order restricting mail-in ballots nationwide. His goal is clear: _make it harder for women, communities of color, working people, seniors, and anyone who can't take time off work to vote._

[_**We have to act now, Peter. If you believe our elections must stay accessible, safe, and secure in California, add your name to protect mail-in voting →**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129187692/613559442/924422295?refcode=SW_EM_PT_180DO_260410_1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MDY5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNGY0NDExNy1mMDM0LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=F2_90AId1VkxX5gUBhrywv25qeCdtnXN9VTaiG6USM8=&emci=1adbb2a2-e234-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=04f44117-f034-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=53530144)

---

This is just the start. Trump’s _SAVE Act_ aims to completely dismantle California’s mail-in voting system and disenfranchise millions.

But here’s the truth: Californians rely on mail-in voting because it works. It’s safe, reliable, and it allows more people to participate in our democracy. That’s why Trump hates it.

clean_body: | ~ | | Peter, I’ve gotten a lot of pushback since I first announced I was running for Congress. People said I was too young. That I didn’t look or act like a Congressman. That my legislative priorities were too pie-in-the-sky. But there’s one subject Republicans can’t get enough of attacking me for: not being rich. What they don’t realize is that their favorite attack line is actually something we need more of. We need and deserve young, working, everyday people in Congress who know firsthand the struggles of the working class – and I’m proud to represent us. But increasing our ranks means building an unbeatable organizing movement, and to do that, I need as much grassroots support as I can get. I need you , Peter. ~ | ~ I’ll never apologize for having humble beginnings – because my family fought to give me what chances I’ve had. My abuela, mom, and aunt fled Cuba in the 1960s with no money, and without knowing English. My abuela worked multiple factory jobs just to give her kids a better shot. It’s her legacy I’m carrying forward when I walk onto the House floor, Peter. Because working people know – we’re in this together. But let’s be real: You shouldn’t have to be working class to care about working class priorities. You don’t need to be rejected by an apartment, or become houseless, or drive Uber to make ends meet – all of which I’ve done – to know that our economy isn’t working for everybody.
