He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | First Invеstmеnt Updаtеs brоught tо уоu bу Іnception Media, LLC. ### **Help us defeat the mainstream media and promote capitalism and American exceptionalism.**
### **[Support The Capitalist, become a paid subscriber today:](https://substack.com/redirect/c6cb6d58-7cef-42f3-9134-1c3754bf9555?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

* * *
* * *
**Meta just unveiled its long-awaited AI model.** "Muse" is the first major product to emerge from its **[newly formed Meta Super Intelligence Labs.](https://substack.com/redirect/f77fca6d-9a51-4e38-9ec4-0b6025b201e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** On paper it sounds impressive. In reality it arrives late, under enormous pressure, and carrying the heavy baggage of Meta's long string of expensive laboratory flops.
Mark Zuckerberg and his team should be acutely aware that this venture must finally deliver real money. **[Ninety-eight percent of Meta's roughly $200 billion in annual revenue](https://substack.com/redirect/5be6a5d9-98cf-462a-aa67-d107b71d221f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** still comes from advertising on its social media platforms. After years of pouring tens of billions into virtual reality, "the Metaverse", and other "Labs" experiments that have largely flopped, investors are running out of patience. The biggest success story Meta can claim in the last fifteen years was Instagram -- **and they didn 't invent that; they just bought it.**
Morningstar analyst Malik Ahmed Khan captured the moment perfectly: _**["I think Meta had to show investors and operators they have been working on something of substance."](https://substack.com/redirect/5be6a5d9-98cf-462a-aa67-d107b71d221f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**_[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/5be6a5d9-98cf-462a-aa67-d107b71d221f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)Translation: after burning a ton of cash on one shiny distraction after another, Meta desperately needed to demonstrate it can still innovate, especially **[in the one area that actually matters right now](https://substack.com/redirect/5be6a5d9-98cf-462a-aa67-d107b71d221f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** (and that they have also **[burned a ton of cash on,](https://substack.com/redirect/c96cca85-82c7-4402-a5e5-631b678e3a73?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**) which is AI driven advertising.

* If you have outstanding credit card debt, getting a new 0% intro APR credit card could help ease the pressure while you pay down your balances.
* Our credit card experts identified top credit cards that are perfect for anyone looking to pay down debt and not add to it!
* Some are even offering generous welcome bonuses up to $250! Click through to see what all the hype is about.

[Get yours now](https://substack.com/redirect/e5b660b2-920f-4ffe-97d4-fcc3c3a16d02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
**The problem is timing.** **[Meta is arriving late to a game](https://substack.com/redirect/5be6a5d9-98cf-462a-aa67-d107b71d221f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that has already matured. OpenAI and Anthropic have been in the trenches for years, enduring the early rocky starts that the world was willing to forgive because AI itself was brand new. Those models -- ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini -- are now solid enough to be wired directly into enterprise systems. Even Apple, rather than spend billions building its own data centers from scratch, has chosen to **[plug proven models from OpenAI and Anthropic into Siri.](https://substack.com/redirect/0da9a058-1f95-43c3-b4cd-1f1983495361?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** The era of "build everything yourself or die" is over. The winners are the ones who can integrate fast and deliver reliable value.
**Meta has no such grace period.** **[It must prove,](https://substack.com/redirect/0da9a058-1f95-43c3-b4cd-1f1983495361?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and prove VERY quickly, that its new model **[can stand](https://substack.com/redirect/f77fca6d-9a51-4e38-9ec4-0b6025b201e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/f77fca6d-9a51-4e38-9ec4-0b6025b201e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[shoulder-to-shoulder with the established players.](https://substack.com/redirect/f77fca6d-9a51-4e38-9ec4-0b6025b201e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** Anything less will be seen as another expensive laboratory experiment in a long line of them.
**The pressure is not abstract.** Wall Street is already trying to **[offload a $3 billion slice of Meta's Prometheus data center project in New Albany, Ohio.](https://substack.com/redirect/cd32a0ff-691d-4119-88d5-e36c700265c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** That single facility was supposed to be a cornerstone of Meta's AI ambitions. Instead, it is becoming a visible symbol of the enormous capital expenditure the company is still burning through while it hunts for the next big thing after social media and right now **[they can't even get it the power it needs.](https://substack.com/redirect/cd32a0ff-691d-4119-88d5-e36c700265c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/cd32a0ff-691d-4119-88d5-e36c700265c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**The horizon is not clear.** Looming lawsuits tied to the decades of documented harm caused by Meta's social platforms -- particularly the damage to children and teenagers -- are gathering force.

[New SSRS Poll on Donald Trump's Approval](https://substack.com/redirect/a5912436-5bba-4079-a356-e8f2648cda29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Donald Trump: King of the Losers
Let's start with the data, because the data is extraordinary.
Donald Trump is currently **polling worse than any president at this point in a second term in the history of modern polling**. That's what CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten found when he ran the numbers: "Oh my goodness gracious. What a disaster!"
[](https://substack.com/redirect/752928e3-afd7-4077-bc77-d8bae428a69f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Overall, [Trump's job approval sits at just 35% in the most recent CNN poll](https://substack.com/redirect/a5912436-5bba-4079-a356-e8f2648cda29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), with 64% disapproving -- one point off his all-time low. A University of Massachusetts Amherst survey puts him even lower, at 33% approval and 62% disapproval, the worst reading in that poll's history for Trump in his second term.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a5912436-5bba-4079-a356-e8f2648cda29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump's net approval among independent voters has hit -45 points. For context: Nixon was at -36 points at the height of Watergate. Trump is nearly ten points worse. On the economy specifically, 65% of Americans say his policies have made things worse, a higher share than said the same about Joe Biden at any point during his presidency, and higher than Carter during the depths of stagflation in the 1970s.
[On 10 of the 12 major issues tracked by Morning Consult](https://substack.com/redirect/8fc8907d-3bde-4c85-84d2-e2abf0e349c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Trump is underwater. His only remaining areas of relative strength are national security and immigration and even those are eroding fast. Immigration, once his strongest issue, is also starting to slip in several recent polls as the reality of mass deportation raids, shootings of American citizens by ICE agents, and economic disruption begins to cut through.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8fc8907d-3bde-4c85-84d2-e2abf0e349c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Trump promised a lot of winning and ironically this is the first time he is truly outshining his presidential peers. [The Newsweek article that quoted Mike directly put it plainly](https://substack.com/redirect/d6e3e180-2e6d-48ff-862c-202d441545ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): he has never seen the fundamentals for an incumbent party this bad heading into a midterm election. Possibly ever.
So here's your well-deserved crown, President Trump. All hail! King of the losers!
* * *
### So Democrats Are Going to Win. Here's the Complicated Part.
The fundamentals of this race are so bad that Mike argues Democrats could focus on nothing, run no coherent message, offer no unified agenda, and still take back the House. The generic ballot consistently shows Democrats with a 6 to 8 point advantage. A wave is coming.
But winning isn't the same as governing. And governing for Latino voters is something neither party has figured out how to do.
Once Democrats win there will be a pitched, bitter internal battle between the progressive and establishment wings of the party over who gets to claim the mandate. Mike argues that this is entirely the wrong fight to be having. The ideological construct of left vs. center is a distraction from the real question: are you actually delivering for the people who voted for you?
**The answer, for Latino voters, is no. And it hasn 't been yes for a very long time.**
* * *
### The California Problem Nobody Wants to Own
Here's the part of the episode that should make every Latino politician in California deeply uncomfortable.
[A recent Los Angeles Times article, which referenced a UC Berkeley California Policy Lab report released March 31st, documented what many already knew but few were willing to say: working class Latinos are leaving California.](https://substack.com/redirect/4b7c5e91-f91c-4c47-9c3c-11854665e1d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Not billionaires. Not millionaires. Working families, driven out by housing costs, by the cost of groceries, by a state that has become genuinely unaffordable for the people who built it.
[The UCLA Latino Policy and Politics Institute's State of Latinos in California 2026 report](https://substack.com/redirect/e4f930e6-2ba4-4afb-950f-f06cb45952be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), released the same week, showed that 63% of Latino children and youth in California are enrolled in Medi-Cal. 58% of Latino renter households are cost-burdened, including 29% who are severely burdened -- spending over half their income on housing. The median value of Latino-owned homes is $229,000 less than that of non-Latino-owned homes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e4f930e6-2ba4-4afb-950f-f06cb45952be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
California Democrats have a supermajority in the state legislature. They control the governor's office. They control every constitutional office in the state. They have the votes to do something about this. And they haven't.
Mike asks a simple question: why. His answer is uncomfortable. The political incentives don't require it. The white progressive base of the California Democratic Party already has housing. They don't need more of it. And Latino politicians, rather than challenging that dynamic, have largely chosen to go along to get along, to carry water for interests that don't serve their community, because that's what you do if you want the consulting contract, the invite to the press conference, the title.
* * *
### The Republican Side Is No Better
And before any Republican readers feel too comfortable: Mike has the same message for you.
Latino voters who crossed over to Trump in 2024 did so out of economic desperation, not ideological alignment. But if you're a Latino Republican who isn't loudly and publicly calling out the nativism, the anti-immigrant terror, the gleeful cruelty of deportation enforcement against working families... well then Mike has a message for you too, and it's not gentle.
The point isn't which party is slightly less bad. **The point is that neither party is building a pathway to the middle class for Latino families**. Neither party is offering pro-growth, pro-construction, pro-working class policies alongside a pro-immigrant, pro-pathway-to-citizenship agenda. And polling shows that this is exactly what Latino voters want.

Mike Madrid flies solo this week and delivers the most data-packed, unfiltered episode of the cycle. | | and | Apr 10 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | The Latino Vote Podcast Word of the Day: 'GALLIVANTING' That's exactly what Chuck Rocha is out doing somewhere leaving Mike Madrid in the pilot seat this episode. No filter. No back-and-forth. Just one of the sharpest minds in Latino politics, a pile of polling data, and a lot of things that need to be said out loud. Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work. | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- | | ---|---|--- Donald Trump: King of the Losers Let's start with the data, because the data is extraordinary. Donald Trump is currently polling worse than any president at this point in a second term in the history of modern polling. That's what CNN chief data analyst Harry Enten found when he ran the numbers: "Oh my goodness gracious. What a disaster!" Overall, , with 64% disapproving -- one point off his all-time low. A University of Massachusetts Amherst survey puts him even lower, at 33% approval and 62% disapproval, the worst reading in that poll's history for Trump in his second term. | | ---|---|--- Trump's net approval among independent voters has hit -45 points. For context: Nixon was at -36 points at the height of Watergate. Trump is nearly ten points worse. On the economy specifically, 65% of Americans say his policies have made things worse, a higher share than said the same about Joe Biden at any point during his presidency, and higher than Carter during the depths of stagflation in the 1970s. , Trump is underwater. His only remaining areas of relative strength are national security and immigration and even those are eroding fast. Immigration, once his strongest issue, is also starting to slip in several recent polls as the reality of mass deportation raids, shootings of American citizens by ICE agents, and economic disruption begins to cut through. | | ---|---|--- Trump promised a lot of winning and ironically this is the first time he is truly outshining his presidential peers. : he has never seen the fundamentals for an incumbent party this bad heading into a midterm election. Possibly ever. So here's your well-deserved crown, President Trump. All hail! King of the losers! So Democrats Are Going to Win. Here's the Complicated Part. The fundamentals of this race are so bad that Mike argues Democrats could focus on nothing, run no coherent message, offer no unified agenda, and still take back the House. The generic ballot consistently shows Democrats with a 6 to 8 point advantage. A wave is coming. But winning isn't the same as governing. And governing for Latino voters is something neither party has figured out how to do. Once Democrats win there will be a pitched, bitter internal battle between the progressive and establishment wings of the party over who gets to claim the mandate. Mike argues that this is entirely the wrong fight to be having. The ideological construct of left vs. center is a distraction from the real question: are you actually delivering for the people who voted for you? The answer, for Latino voters, is no. And it hasn 't been yes for a very long time. The California Problem Nobody Wants to Own Here's the part of the episode that should make every Latino politician in California deeply uncomfortable. Not billionaires. Not millionaires. Working families, driven out by housing costs, by the cost of groceries, by a state that has become genuinely unaffordable for the people who built it. , released the same week, showed that 63% of Latino children and youth in California are enrolled in Medi-Cal. 58% of Latino renter households are cost-burdened, including 29% who are severely burdened -- spending over half their income on housing. The median value of Latino-owned homes is $229,000 less than that of non-Latino-owned homes. | | ---|---|--- California Democrats have a supermajority in the state legislature. They control the governor's office. They control every constitutional office in the state. They have the votes to do something about this. And they haven't. Mike asks a simple question: why. His answer is uncomfortable. The political incentives don't require it. The white progressive base of the California Democratic Party already has housing. They don't need more of it. And Latino politicians, rather than challenging that dynamic, have largely chosen to go along to get along, to carry water for interests that don't serve their community, because that's what you do if you want the consulting contract, the invite to the press conference, the title. The Republican Side Is No Better And before any Republican readers feel too comfortable: Mike has the same message for you. Latino voters who crossed over to Trump in 2024 did so out of economic desperation, not ideological alignment. But if you're a Latino Republican who isn't loudly and publicly calling out the nativism, the anti-immigrant terror, the gleeful cruelty of deportation enforcement against working families... well then Mike has a message for you too, and it's not gentle. The point isn't which party is slightly less bad. The point is that neither party is building a pathway to the middle class for Latino families. Neither party is offering pro-growth, pro-construction, pro-working class policies alongside a pro-immigrant, pro-pathway-to-citizenship agenda. And polling shows that this is exactly what Latino voters want. Time to lace up our sneakers and get going!

Peter,

Early morning runs through the neighborhood, the sun just starting to rise, and the sound of my sneakers pounding the pavement. Just 8 years ago I was just a concerned citizen and mom, trying to stay active and clear my head.[](https://trk.join.jenforcongress._cmVjdXJyaW5nPXRydWUmZXhfdGlkPTIwMjYwNDEwX1JPLUFKLjExMDExN190MTg2ODgxNS0yMDY4JnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj0yMDI2MDQxMF9STy1BSi4xMTAxMTdfdDE4Njg4MTUtMjA2OCJ9/RfEt89E1_WZZ0T7J6IgF0A)Fast forward to today, and I'm running in the most competitive race in America. It's a far cry from those quiet neighborhood streets, but my commitment to our conservative values remains unwavering.
As a Navy veteran and a proud conservative, I've seen firsthand the impact that reckless spending, overregulation, and a lack of accountability can have on our communities. That's why I'm fighting every day to bring common sense back to Washington.
But I need your help. The liberal machine is pouring millions into my opponent's campaign, and we can't let them drown out our message...! That's why I'm counting on you to help me stay in this fight.

Fellow Conservative,

As we approach the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, I’ve been thinking a lot about the courage of our Founding Fathers.

250 years ago, 56 patriots risked everything — their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor — to create the greatest country the world has ever seen. A nation founded on liberty, opportunity, and the God-given rights we still cherish today.

That same spirit of patriotism is what called me to service. **On my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and later became a Navy SEAL.** I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the Constitution and the American way of life my parents taught me to love.

Today, as a proud Minnesotan running for the U.S. Senate, I’m fighting to protect that same legacy. But while Republicans continue standing for the core values that built Minnesota and America — strong families, secure borders, safe streets, free enterprise, and real opportunity — _**the Democratic Party has been overtaken by something completely unrecognizable.**_

clean_body: Have a look at this picture and let me know what you think | - Fellow Conservative, As we approach the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence, I’ve been thinking a lot about the courage of our Founding Fathers. 250 years ago, 56 patriots risked everything — their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor — to create the greatest country the world has ever seen. A nation founded on liberty, opportunity, and the God-given rights we still cherish today. That same spirit of patriotism is what called me to service. On my 18th birthday in October 2001, just weeks after 9/11, I joined the Marine Corps and later became a Navy SEAL. I deployed nine times to over 70 countries, risking my life to defend the Constitution and the American way of life my parents taught me to love. Today, as a proud Minnesotan running for the U.S. Senate, I’m fighting to protect that same legacy. But while Republicans continue standing for the core values that built Minnesota and America — strong families, secure borders, safe streets, free enterprise, and real opportunity — the Democratic Party has been overtaken by something completely unrecognizable. Just take a look at the photo below: This is Lieutenant Governor Peggy Flanagan, she’s my main opponent in this race. You can see here she is cosplaying as a Somali Muslim. It smells exactly like another Elizabeth Warren — cultural appropriation at its most cynical, and we don’t need another radical like that representing Minnesota in the United States Senate. That is not the Minnesota I grew up in — playing hockey in a working-class family and learning to love this country. It’s not the America I risked my life to defend across nine deployments. And it’s not the future any of us want for our children as we head toward America’s 250th birthday. My name is Adam Schwarze. I’m not a career politician. I’m a regular Minnesotan with a Master’s from Harvard, a Johns Hopkins certificate in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA — but my proudest achievement is serving our nation as a Navy SEAL and Marine Corps veteran to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. This is just one glaring symptom of how far the Democrats have fallen. Under Walz and Flanagan, Minnesota has been dragged left by radical policies that fueled the violent 2020 unrest in Minneapolis, defunded our police, and burdened hardworking families with higher taxes and crushing inflation. While our streets burned, she pushed lawsuits against law enforcement, undermining the very officers keeping us safe. If these radicals aren’t stopped here in Minnesota, they’ll gain unstoppable momentum to push their extreme national agenda across the country: open borders, abolishing ICE and the police, boys in girls’ sports, attacks on free enterprise, and even a growing pro-Hamas wing that rejects the very principles our Founding Fathers fought and risked everything for. Hi there, Jasmine and Sam with Team Molder here with some updates from the campaign trail! Mule Day 2026 is right around the corner! Join our team TOMORROW, Saturday April 11 in Columbia celebrating all things Mule. The team will be out in full force, passing out buttons and stickers, talking to voters, etc. If you’re interested, reply to this email and we can get you signed up. We’d love to see you out there! Before we get into the rest of the updates - a special thank you from Chaz for being a part of such a strong Q1: _The energy and the momentum is real. If you haven’t already seen, we raised over $600,000 in the first three months of the year. Our seven month total of $1.8 million is the most raised by any 5th, 6th or 7th District candidate since 2016 — except Rep. Aftyn Behn in last December's special election. I could not be more grateful for the outpouring of support y’all have shown me. It’s what keeps me going when the days are long and there’s still more work to do. We know, however, that meeting people in the communities is the key to winning this race. That’s why I’m so proud that in the first three months of the year we hosted and/or attended over 20 community gatherings across the district. The fundraising is important but the community gatherings are where this race is won and we plan to continue that through November._ _I’m so grateful to have you with me on this journey. We can win!_ [**Read Vivian Jones’ article in The Tennessean about our Q1 fundraising numbers**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_tFvk01vJ-aysqXYwv5k_g~~/AAUS1hA~/DFP9kAxOLT2qoZWV0Err9ZJtPdd1qAOlmSr8fMHp9_fR4gO1Xhp-ia098AnRQ53wsvomHLo63ov0l45O_FRxLKhWEeTxE7v3Yeiy_pokU6e86Fx1QKplxyC3afUJVIW9SVEygCwTOuxfH5gWAgzQuj2xmzsI3HIB0BD9rH1W9FsSxDEitKEDu5GqVANIaztSNmidoCP74KmcyK5tPQ3HXUhh6V1O3VBv54yAtxFUGX2NwFe8pi5fSztlJJWrMu6v) [****](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_tFvk01vJ-aysqXYwv5k_g~~/AAUS1hA~/DFP9kAxOLT2qoZWV0Err9ZJtPdd1qAOlmSr8fMHp9_fR4gO1Xhp-ia098AnRQ53wsvomHLo63ov0l45O_FRxLKhWEeTxE7v3Yeiy_pokU6e86Fx1QKplxyC3afUJVIW9SVEygCwTOuxfH5gWAgzQuj2xmzsI3HIB0BD9rH1W9FsSxDEitKEDu5GqVANIaztSNmidoCP74KmcyK5tPQ3HXUhh6V1O3VBv54yAtxFUGX2NwFe8pi5fSztlJJWrMu6v)**🚨 We're hiring! 🚨** ****_Join the Dream Team!_ Our team is growing and we wanted to share the news with you! We are excited to announce we are partnering with the 2026 National Democracy Summer School to bring on interns this summer! The program will run from Monday June 22nd to Friday August 7th and will require a 15-20 hour/week commitment. If you are interested, or know someone who is interested, you can find the additional information and the link to apply [HERE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/82JTJMZ8oxn5EpCQ1htYew~~/AAUS1hA~/VnyoDz8y1n3SHhf4Gzs68lypqKy8vtQ07veIsfsF6nEaacR25h8jqwGJK1EA4k8FGxJk8qWJSX16MeNZV845thd82R75NhC-WipPLnN1vyp1JeJR5jwSg0TMEbLMbIkRCSvfqJAmk9OtOvMd_UBlBk7JcaoO3E5JbZUyshzrMeoJO4WMkhbBsJxyAHWBDE9Me815dTG-ifAFcHUk0Au6Kg~~). **Traveling the 5th
** March was one of our busiest months yet, and we are just getting started. From community events and meet and greets to fundraisers and political meetings, Chaz is showing up in every corner of this district. Because that is how we win. Check out photos from our events across the district. From Davidson County to Williamson to Maury and beyond, we are meeting and listening to voters. The month opened with a packed room in Green Hills where the crowd watched voters across Texas, North Carolina, and Arkansa cast their primary ballots. The energy and optimism in the crowd were hard to miss. Chaz spent time with a father and daughter who both work in healthcare, listening as they described how cuts in the Big Beautiful Bill are stripping necessary funding from their hospitals and the patients who depend on them. Chaz sat down with a group of Williamson County voters who have long felt left behind by both parties. On his way out, one voter stopped him: "I thought the Democratic party had left me behind decades ago. You made me think it could be different." Chaz joined This Week with Bob Mueller to talk about the race and the issues we’re hearing on the ground. If you haven’t had a chance, you can give it a watch [HERE](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/kzzPi-cact-YhpzhWDWlrw~~/AAUS1hA~/Av1uI9jNhVi1mvwCsCi8tvProwZ8G2pfDYvB4045dxQpIkz5se4z37vxPnPKIwfNQwdoVc_V0bxIUy4wOsEAjQh27bTFgXfNMvKy0jTguV-M2oCbDSB0RT1bFGvcEAi5VIWInkETbr5JI9Ntr5Z2uvLfwa2KM6CPYrOzEaFWbZvGLAkUcW_L1wSwlzMa1igQXRoshS7-jK-SHJ4T0hq3Gw~~). This month we also had our largest crowd yet in Forest Hills! One gentleman shared a story about how he had knocked doors for decades but was nervous because of the political climate these days. This is exactly why Chaz is running, because too many voices are telling us to fear each other—or that the person with a different yard sign is the enemy. We’re turning that around with this campaign. A few days later, Chaz joined voters in Williamson County for a Saturday brunch where rural healthcare dominated the conversation. Neighbors shared stories about family members driving over an hour just to see a specialist. It was a powerful reminder of what is at stake in this race and why we need a congressman who will fight to expand access to care, not cut it. We closed out the week with a great conversation with a group of Democrats, Independents, and Republicans who are sick of Andy Ogles’ antics. One of Chaz’s favorite events of the month was a gathering at Bad Idea Brewery in Columbia, where Chaz was joined by his family and the neighbors who have known him his whole life. The room was full of warmth, with folks sharing stories about the kid who used to babysit their children and mow their lawns.
The campaign set a new crowd record at a beautiful backyard event in Nashville. When asked about his proudest accomplishment as Mayor, Chaz pointed to the Columbia Mayor's Youth Council and the next generation of young leaders it has helped inspire. Chaz and the team joined the Antioch community for the annual Southeast Egg Hunt, spending time with neighbors, reconnecting with familiar faces, and meeting a number of first-time voters who will be heading to the polls this fall. Chaz stopped by Bethel AME Church in Columbia, where he ran into his third grade teacher, Mrs. Richardson. She taught him cursive and multiplication -- and, perhaps more importantly, how to love and respect the people who show up for you every day.
We closed out the month with Rendezvous’ world famous ribs and took plenty of leftovers home. A great end to a successful month and quarter! **We need your help!** We are so grateful for those of you who are looking for ways to help now. Here are the three biggest ways you can help our campaign:
1. Help us spread our message! Follow us on social media, help amplify our posts. Share this newsletter with your networks. Talk to your family and friends about us.
2. Friendraising! Can you bring three friends who don’t already know Chaz into the fold? Are you interested in hosting an event for folks to meet Chaz? Let us know!
3. Join us at upcoming events! If you’re interested in joining us at Mule Day or other events, respond to this email!

Follow along on social media as we travel District 5! [Instagram: @ChazMolder](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/L4F-UGXKP1-nf4G0RNYGRQ~~/AAUS1hA~/UkCCdiF4LaAcqZrIcW9nvXUZBoEzbF7wmgrVgyhxlUlXFGbkv8T29Lb9HGwpP1Q_VxHWScng61iwwaREswiVqk9cGLMpatYxQkbPhAI9QcHwM_WwmyAMBGeP3jAaoSNlsLqR7YPt9etEBEL9hvq6Og~~)
[Twitter: @ChazMolder](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/0X6r4F69PPpS8UB82s5c4g~~/AAUS1hA~/DFm926EEGRoAuVz_cVT244QbllYZkSldfNVYfLmUZy3bNuPnhqTSzFkFpfCIo--58O2nIjuK5-Sq34cGD4Igyr1ClTHyqeRSraNHEg5WKn3cQAwziyl7oH3olwYdt2aB)
[Facebook: Molder for Congress](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/ycFx16n0jk85IBf0adn67w~~/AAUS1hA~/Ue-U9r_Z1UYZAWddxkyIF0K9HjN9968MrOqbvxcrCX6acDlcEm-7WlUGY9yvWcfSv1WqXoKRP4vAXKk03GhWEuR9f5rHdhsALMW8UvOV6KmU03WczhkGctj82OgFFtI-)
[TikTok: @ChazMolder](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/f8bLPjCFdhraLGCySva05Q~~/AAUS1hA~/epFLRs6bSRzMhuX3DHGfRPhQIsUY1eyERINyPN1tviLVIBwhD7fn-vuf0YYbaMh4rAtQ14hXsYAjjyCiIoy5JiM5UiJ6cXCbNc4Y6N1-9qWYGPX0iG1PUXTurdZi7wRE) And check out our website [www.chazmolder.com](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/_nXY-3ipylQrrRS6CmGb-A~~/AAUS1hA~/SSLu4I-iCk2Z6UGh9_1kRwD7z75FsBzSKHTmjbn1w7_MVVgYQ9bnOYTlW0LkxDHdiaEMrvtUzHiQBYSivoDJozlzP5LK_aSviokCXBH61S6t25vYnofD36bEXPTJCGu7) We are so grateful for your continued support! name: Jason Crow
subject: Following the rules isn't enough
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jason Crow for Congress
body:
We’re fighting for a system that delivers for everyone. |
#
---
I’ll be honest, folks, not a lot about my background would make you think I’d be here today as a Democrat. I grew up in a rural town. I saw my family working hard and following the rules — yet the American Dream still eluded them. I worked construction jobs and enlisted in the National Guard to pay my way through school. Then I went active duty — and was sent to war. I saw oil executives and elites getting richer while my working-class brothers and sisters took the burden of fighting and dying. We have a system where the corporations and lobbyists at the top always get more powerful, while workers, farmers, and small business owners, work day in and day out without getting ahead. That’s unacceptable. **[That’s why I’m a Democrat. I don’t want government to solve all my problems, I just want fairness and a level playing field. And that’s why I’m asking for your help today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129218380/613606870/-42505523?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260410_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzN2Y0NTQyNy0wNzM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8NlzgUWaPsdwQDbjkLHN4fHfKg2QBDVF54id2nhnDHM=)** | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129218388/613606879/-42505523?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260410_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzN2Y0NTQyNy0wNzM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8NlzgUWaPsdwQDbjkLHN4fHfKg2QBDVF54id2nhnDHM=)
---

I grew up in a rural town. I saw my family working hard and following the rules — yet the American Dream still eluded them. I worked construction jobs and enlisted in the National Guard to pay my way through school. Then I went active duty — and was sent to war. I saw oil executives and elites getting richer while my working-class brothers and sisters took the burden of fighting and dying. We have a system where the corporations and lobbyists at the top always get more powerful, while workers, farmers, and small business owners, work day in and day out without getting ahead. **But thanks to Senate Democrats’ relentless fight, we’re inches away from DESTROYING this bill for good — and SAVING voting rights!**

[**We’re calling on EVERY supporter reading this to join the fight and THANK Senate Democrats for defending our democracy »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/106434?t=7&akid=23564%2E878179%2Em2fKPk) | [**THANK SENATE DEMOCRATS: DONATE $3 TO SIGN »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/106434?t=8&akid=23564%2E878179%2Em2fKPk)

It’s clear: Trump wouldn’t be doing this if he wasn’t TERRIFIED. He KNOWS Democrats are on track to end his MAGA trifecta in November.

_**I’m Tobias Read, Oregon Secretary of State, and I’m sounding the alarm, because this is unconstitutional and it could fundamentally disrupt how our elections are run.**_

This is not about “election integrity.” This is about control.

States — not the White House — are responsible for administering elections. That’s not just tradition, **it’s written into the Constitution.** And when any administration tries to bypass that, we all have a responsibility to speak up. **[That’s why I’m asking you to take action today: Add your name to our petition to demand this executive order be blocked and our voting rights protected.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129218936/613608512/999597837?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiY2JlMzBmOS0wNzM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=74LzvmqhU6sq3pYAkxKf-wp6aHZmaXz_Ba0KaoUWGL4=&emci=203315ba-ee34-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=bcbe30f9-0735-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=30662126)**

But they’re counting on our silence.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Robert Garcia for Congress
body:
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129219484/613610201/938567526?refcode=header&noskip=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDUyY2I4Yy0wOTM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yeHlHcrwefb4t1tMh6G-_RuW7lYq2n-NIo17srSdVxo=)
New reports suggest that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth may have tried to profit off the very war he helped oversee — **with attempts to invest in defense companies just *weeks* before military action in Iran began.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129219485/613610202/789508428?refcode=260410_RG_re-hegseth&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MDUyY2I4Yy0wOTM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yeHlHcrwefb4t1tMh6G-_RuW7lYq2n-NIo17srSdVxo=)
Let that sink in: While American troops were being put in harm’s way and families braced for the consequences of another war, someone at the highest levels of government may have been trying to cash in.
If true, this isn’t just corruption — it’s a national security threat. Because decisions about war and peace should NEVER be influenced by personal financial gain.

I’m not going to stop fighting for Medicare for All until we get it.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260410-6117-footer&t=1&akid=6117%2E420207%2EjZABKc)
Peter,
**While Trump is busy starting illegal wars and manufacturing chaos, tens of millions of Americans have to choose between rent and medical bills.**
That’s a political decision — a callous choice made by politicians taking kickbacks from greedy insurance and pharmaceutical companies. Then when working families demand a better option, those same politicians turn around and claim there’s nothing we can do about it.
I refuse to accept that answer.
Especially when this administration just asked for $1.5 trillion for their military budget, all while making cuts to the social services millions depend on.
**They have the money — they’re just choosing who to spend it on. And it isn’t you.**
Voters across the country know this, and they’re sick of it. 70% of Americans say our healthcare system is in crisis. And a whopping 41% of adults carry crushing medical debt.
I re-introduce Medicare for All every session because I know health care is a human right. Not a privilege or a commodity to be sold. I’m pushing my colleagues hard in Congress to get behind it, and I won’t stop fighting until we get this done.
**_Everyone_ deserves healthcare, Peter. And no one should have to struggle this hard just to stay alive.**
Because we don’t suffer from scarcity in this country. We suffer from greed, and we know exactly who's feeding it. It’s time we put people over profits, and care over corporate interests — once and for all.

subject: “CONSERVATIVE CASSIDY” CAUGHT BEGGING DEMOCRATS TO SAVE HIS CAMPAIGN
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Julia Letlow for Louisiana
body:
“Deep down, Cassidy isn’t as conservative as he must pretend to be.” — Robert Mann

| | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=da0efb6dbf&e=95355a072c)
| | | | | | **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
** April 10, 2026
**“CONSERVATIVE CASSIDY” CAUGHT BEGGING DEMOCRATS TO SAVE HIS CAMPAIGN** _“Deep down, Cassidy isn’t as conservative as he must pretend to be.” — Robert Mann_
**BATON ROUGE, LA** – On Monday night, “Conservative Cassidy” went looking for help.
He did not call a Republican activist, a conservative leader, a Trump supporter, or anyone connected to the Republican base he claims to represent. Instead, Bill Cassidy called Robert Mann, a progressive columnist, and pitched himself as the “least extreme, least MAGA candidate in the race,” asking Mann to make that case to his liberal readers and encourage them to switch their registration and vote for Cassidy in the Republican primary.
The problem is that Cassidy never told Mann the conversation was off the record. Now the entire world can see the gap between the campaign Cassidy is running in public and the one he is running behind closed doors.
**EXCERPTS FROM MANN’S COLUMN:****The private campaign Cassidy is running behind the scenes:
**_“Cassidy and his allies are urging progressive and moderate Democrats to consider switching parties, becoming Republicans, and voting for Cassidy in the Republican primary... Cassidy has been making this argument in conversations and phone calls to various people for at least the past couple of months.”_
**What Cassidy is telling Democrats:
**_“He’s essentially telling people like me in private conversations: I’m really not as crazy and MAGA-like as I’ve had to sound over the past year and a half.”_
**The hypocrisy of Cassidy’s television campaign:**_“I’m not sure how to make an effective, persuasive argument that Cassidy is the more reasonable, moderate candidate in the race and deserves our support because of that, when he’s pouring millions of dollars into an ugly ad campaign to persuade us that the true liberal is Julia Letlow.”_
**The two-faced nature of the whole operation:**_“In pursuit of the office, he’s twisted himself into something unrecognizable to people on both sides. He’s neither fish nor fowl. And that’s Cassidy’s fundamental problem: He has no home in either camp.”_
**Congresswoman Julia Letlow issued the following statement:** "Louisiana Republicans deserve a senator who tells them the truth, stands with President Trump, and does not run one campaign in public and another one in private. I am proud to be the Trump-endorsed conservative in this race, and I will never apologize for standing with the President or with the people of Louisiana."
**Letlow for Louisiana Communications Director Katherine Thordahl added:** “Bill Cassidy got caught. He voted to convict President Trump, he is running third in the primary, and now he is asking Democrats to rescue him from Louisiana Republicans. Cassidy finally said out loud what his campaign has spent millions trying to hide.”
**THE CHOICE IS CLEAR** This race presents a clear choice. Julia Letlow is the Trump-endorsed conservative in this race. Bill Cassidy is the senator who voted to convict President Trump and is now begging Democrats for help in a Republican primary.
Cassidy and his allies have burned more than $15 million trying to reinvent his image. One phone call blew it all apart. Louisiana Republicans know exactly who Bill Cassidy is, and on May 16, they will make their voices heard.
Read the full story [HERE](https://julialetlow.us19.list-manage.com/track/click?u=70758973fc60553eda6683b43&id=fc325f6cce&e=95355a072c).

I'm a bit of an infrastructure nerd

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129220439/613613209/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkODMyNDAxMS0wZDM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HWRS50NFSTzxaSWzkAsLld4JnDd8PygiQDGXNmhBRb4=) Can I make a confession? _I’m a bit of an infrastructure nerd._ I know it's not exactly the flashiest issue — and it doesn’t always make the headlines. But whether you’re a Democrat, a Republican, or an unaffiliated voter, I’ll tell you this: You notice infrastructure when it’s working. And you _definitely_ notice when it’s not. Infrastructure impacts how we get to and from everywhere we go: School, work, recreation, places of worship, the list goes on. It impacts how our businesses are able to conduct their operations. It impacts how well our schools are able to teach our kids. It impacts _everything_ — and that’s why it’s so important we get it right. You’ve probably heard me talk a lot about bringing affordable, reliable high-speed internet all throughout the state. It’s easy to think of the internet as a luxury these days — something we only use to scroll through social media or watch television at home. But it’s a lifeline. Because rural hospitals can’t operate at their best without stable, reliable connectivity. Small businesses can’t operate at their best without that access. Infrastructure — including affordable broadband — touches every community across our state. That’s why I was proud to help bring $578 million to our state through the bipartisan infrastructure law to get broadband out to the communities that need it most. No, infrastructure spending will probably never be the first question at a high-stakes debate. But it impacts our lives every single day. And that’s why I’ve made it a top priority of mine in Congress. **_[But I want to be clear: If National Republicans take this seat in the next election, that attention to detail will disappear in the blink of an eye. Instead, someone solely focused on partisan distractions will represent our district — and that means fewer results for Kansas families. Because rural hospitals can’t operate at their best without stable, reliable connectivity. Small businesses can’t operate at their best without that access. Infrastructure — including affordable broadband — touches every community across our state. body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240791%2E444211%2EUlOG81)
I want you to meet Angelina, one of our newest Powered by People volunteers.
Angelina is a volunteer deputy registrar (VDRs can legally register people to vote in Texas, a state that doesn’t have online voter registration), a full time student and the president of the newly organized UTRGV-Brownsville College Democrats.
I spent the day with her on Tuesday, where she and other amazing PXP volunteers helped us meet and register 147 students to vote.
In every instance, we asked the student’s permission to stay in touch with them, and in every case we will personally maintain contact over the next 6 months to make sure we answer every question they have about the midterm elections and continue to encourage them to vote until we’ve confirmed their ballot has been cast.
This work of personally connecting with and staying in touch with young voters produces big results. In 2024, the young voters we met in this way turned out at over 79%, compared to a state-wide average for young people of between 37-39%.
With Angelina’s help we now have another 147 young voters in our system who will be twice as likely to vote as their peers, and she’s helping us do it in a part of Texas that has among the lowest voter turnout rates in the country.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends!
**🇺🇸 We’ll see you at the GOP Assembly tomorrow!** — The Republican State Assembly is happening this weekend, and we’ll be there covering it live. Stop by our table, say hello, and share what’s on your mind—we’ll also be conducting interviews and reporting in real time throughout the event.
_**If you're a delegate, make sure you check out all our candidate profiles below so you're making the most informed vote! ➡_

**Attorney General:** 🔹 [Michael Allen](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
🔹 [David Wilson](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Secretary of State:**
🔹 [J.J. McKinzie](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
🔹 [James Wiley](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Senate:**
🔹 [Mark Baisley](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) 🔹 [Dathan Jones](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) 🔹 [Janak Joshi](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) 🔹 [George Markert](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) 🔹 [Sean Pond](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**RMV's Governor/Candidate Forum:** 🔹 [At Durango forum, GOP candidates field rotating questions submitted from across Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Listen to the Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Scrutiny is growing over a new law [limiting attorney cooperation with federal immigration authorities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while proposals like prostitution legalization have stalled amid public opposition—[61% against](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)—highlighting a gap between lawmakers and voters. Critics are also questioning whether state leaders are consolidating power in ways that [conflict with the principles they claim to defend](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Federal Heights residents are demanding transparency after the [abrupt firing of police and fire chiefs](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while RTD CEO Debra Johnson announced [she will step down in 2027](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The state Supreme Court [sided with transparency](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in a child abuse records case, and economic pressures persist as businesses cite taxes and regulations in [decisions to leave the state](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Debate continues over [shifting narratives on Iran](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) as polling shows most voters view recent actions as successful despite ongoing concerns about the regime’s capabilities. Meanwhile, internal Democratic divisions are in focus after Rahm Emanuel warned the party has [lost touch with working-class voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
This is your Mountain Minute for Friday, April 10, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[She moved her company to Colorado: Seven months later she decided to leave](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Heather Florio didn’t move her company to Colorado for a short stay.
When she arrived in early 2025, she thought she was putting down roots.
“We came here... at the beginning of January, 2025 with anticipation of this being our permanent home.”
About seven months in, she said the company was having to leave.
“We found out that some laws had changed here in the state of Colorado,” Florio said. “Specifically regarding tax thresholds. We’re looking at double the amount of taxes if we stay here. We are unfortunately having to leave my home state.”
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Poll Finds Colorado Majority Opposes Prostitution Legalization and Questions Wolf Reintroduction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Voters reject prostitution legalization:** A clear majority of Coloradans (61%) oppose legalizing prostitution, including strong opposition from Republicans and unaffiliated voters, after lawmakers floated—and then dropped—the proposal earlier this session.
* **Support grows to halt wolf reintroduction:** About half of voters support suspending the state’s wolf reintroduction program, compared to 39% opposed, signaling continued division over a policy first approved by ballot measure in 2020 and implemented in 2023.
* **Mixed but notable support for immigration cooperation:** A slim majority (51%) say local law enforcement should be allowed to cooperate with federal immigration authorities, with overwhelming Republican support and more divided views among independents and Democrats.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Commentary Questions Whether Colorado Leaders Mirror The Power They Protest](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* **Critics question focus of anti-Trump protests:** Recent “No Kings” rallies in Colorado targeted former President Donald Trump as a threat to democracy, even as the commentary raises concerns that similar warnings may be overlooked at the state level.
* **State policies draw scrutiny on free speech and transparency:** The piece highlights recent legal and legislative actions—including a Supreme Court ruling striking down a Colorado law and concerns over limits on speech and closed-door decision-making—as examples fueling debate over government authority in the state.
* **RTD governance proposal sparks representation concerns:** A legislative proposal to shrink the elected RTD board and add appointed members is cited as raising questions about reduced voter control over a major public agency managing billions in taxpayer funds.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Colorado fought scrutiny—until a lawsuit forced a cleanup](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY RMV EDITORIAL BOARD | COMMENTARY | APRIL 8** _Back in 2019, Colorado’s voter rolls were already showing the problem—if anyone in charge had been willing to look at them. Forty counties had more registered voters than eligible citizens. Call it whatever you want—but it’s not normal._____
**[He lost once. Now he’s back: Why David Willson jumped into Colorado’s AG race late](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | APRIL 8** _For ten years, David Willson stood in Colorado courtrooms defending parents accused of neglect—many of them homeless, addicted or on the verge of losing their children. He learned quickly the system doesn’t operate in clean lines._ ____
**[From Kazakhstan to Colorado: Secretary of State candidate James Wiley’s plan to scrap electronic voting machines](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | APRIL 7** _James Wiley was 7 on Election Night 2000. He remembers the decorations from his birthday staying up for two more weeks while the country waited to find out who had won. He didn’t understand hanging chads or voting machines. At the time, he was living in Almaty, Kazakhstan, where his missionary family had been since he was three months old._**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

On Tuesday morning, the President threatened genocide.
https://secure.ngpvan.com/HfFbjbWZFEabMwl2JhKLmw2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/HfFbjbWZFEabMwl2JhKLmw2]
Reaching a cease-fire with Iran doesn’t just “cancel out” these threats. Threatening to destroy an entire civilization is a despicable and horrific act, and it’s explicitly banned by international law.
Targeting civilians is a war crime. Destroying a country’s civilian infrastructure is a war crime. And even threatening genocide could be a war crime.
Trump’s behavior is reckless, deranged, and evil and we all need to take it seriously.
To my Republican colleagues in Congress: You can’t hide anymore. You have to abandon your blind loyalty and work with us to stop Donald Trump.
Whether that’s through impeachment and removal by Congress, or by invoking the 25th Amendment because the President is mentally unfit to serve — this is not the time for us to wait and see.

# Total Abortion Ban, SNAP Restrictions, Immigration Enforcement, Attack on Marriage Equality, Bathroom Bill
---
| |
**S.1095 is an extreme abortion ban** that would eliminate exceptions for rape, incest, and fatal fetal anomaly, criminalize access to care (including medication abortion), and expand penalties not only for providers but for anyone who helps someone access care.
**A hearing has been scheduled for this upcoming Tuesday, April 14th at 9 AM in Gressette 308.** Our friends at the Women’s Rights and Empowerment Network (WREN), Planned Parenthood Votes! South Atlantic (PPVSAT) , and Palmetto State Abortion Fund (PSAF) are**asking for people to take action using their action links and to send testimony to the committee.**
**Take Action**
1. [**WREN action link**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=bc71673e29&e=edbde6c9b1)
2. [**PSAF S.1095 action link**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=de0a60dea1&e=edbde6c9b1)
3. [**PPSAT Click to Call**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f9fca1b5b7&e=edbde6c9b1)
4. **Sign up to testify:** We are seeking testifiers across all areas. You can [**sign up here**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=ad3283e028&e=edbde6c9b1)**. Spots are extremely limited. If you are unable to secure a spot,** please submit your testimony to the Senate Medical Affairs Committee **by Monday 4/13 at 12:00 PM by emailing**[**smedicomm@scsenate.gov**](mailto:smedicomm@scsenate.gov)**or by mailing your testimony to:**
5. SC Senate Medical Affairs Committee
6. Attention: Research DirectorPO Box 142, 412 Gressette BuildingColumbia, SC 29202
7. **Attend the hearing with us on April 14th at 9 AM in Gressette 308.**
8. **Join us at the United we THRIVE rally on the West Grounds**(side facing Assembly St.) before and after the hearing.

[**H. 4061 (SNAP Restriction Bill)**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=45c5251072&e=edbde6c9b1) was heard in House subcommittee and would limit how people can use SNAP benefits.WREN is proud to work with Wholespire, which leads efforts to improve nutrition and reduce hunger in South Carolina. We join them in opposing this bill, along with similar bills like [**S. 777**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=edb7cacc23&e=edbde6c9b1).[**Please share our social post to help spread accurate information about SNAP benefits.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=00b1f815a1&e=edbde6c9b1)
| | [**H. 4764 (Immigration Enforcement Mandate)**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=82f71f22da&e=edbde6c9b1) has advanced to the Senate.This bill would require local jails to partner with federal immigration officials, using local staff and resources to help enforce federal immigration laws.Please use our partner ACLU’s action links or contact your House representative and urge them to [**VOTE NO on H. 4764.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=be3976314a&e=edbde6c9b1)****[ Take Action](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f9f8da1326&e=edbde6c9b1)
---
**An Attack on Marriage Equality** A concurrent resolution was introduced that directly targets marriage equality by calling for the reversal of Obergefell v. Hodges and promoting a definition of marriage that excludes same-sex couples.We need advocates to speak up now by contacting their legislators, sharing accurate information within their networks, and staying engaged with WREN’s action alerts as we mobilize to ensure that South Carolinians’ values of freedom, dignity, and equal protection under the law are clearly and consistently represented.
---

**Anti-Transgender Bathroom Bill**
---
[**H. 4756 (Anti-Transgender Bathroom Bill)**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=b9ccdb667f&e=edbde6c9b1) is waiting for a decision from the House before it can move forward. The House has paused debate until April 14.While this bill is harmful in any form, the House version does more to limit that harm. We need the House to stand strong and REJECT the Senate amendments.Please use the SC United action link to contact your representative as soon as possible and urge them not to accept the Senate amendments.

# Tell your Senator vote NO on the SAVE Act
---
| |
While Republicans have argued the SAVE Act is needed to safeguard elections, Democrats and voting rights advocates say the legislation would [disenfranchise millions of Americans](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=c716dc4903&e=edbde6c9b1), including married women, by making it harder to register to vote and cast ballots.This would mean that married women who have changed their surname would have to show citizenship documents that match their current legal name.Because a passport or birth certificate may reflect a previous legal name, the legislation would add a new barrier to voter registration for those, such as many married women, who have changed their name, according to the [**League of Women Voters**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=ade9fcfb59&e=edbde6c9b1) and [**Brennan Center for Justice.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=39eb324982&e=edbde6c9b1) Nine percent of Americans, or [**more than 21 million**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=5236fdabff&e=edbde6c9b1) people — including those who don't have a passport and those [**without**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=bf647d8a68&e=edbde6c9b1) a paper copy of their birth certificate — don't have those documents readily available, according to research from the Brennan Center for Justice. [**Read More.**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=050151c0e3&e=edbde6c9b1)[**An explainer on the SAVE Act**](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=d03c600def&e=edbde6c9b1)
---
|
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| | | | | | | | | | |
---
| [|
---](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=88692ea096&e=edbde6c9b1)
| |
These past couple of weeks have been a whirlwind! I had the pleasure of hosting Ambassador Rahm Emanuel on his education tour of South Carolina last week. He visited voters in Spartanburg, Abbeville, Allendale and Charleston and was met with a warm reception throughout. As he traversed the state he told the story of what we are building in Spartanburg, through our community college, universities and Movement 2030. That’s the power of elevating the good work of a committed community.
I also had the pleasure of helping [sixteen Democratic candidates](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=a315e0aa86&e=edbde6c9b1) officially launch their campaigns in Spartanburg. We have folks running from County Council to Congress this year with every house seat challenged and I couldn’t be more proud.
As the Marketing Director of the [250 Revolutionary War Committee in Spartanburg](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=f2c30e493e&e=edbde6c9b1), I had the distinct pleasure of presenting our efforts to the Spartanburg Rotary Club last week and end this week launching the [South Carolina Voter Guide](https://kathrynforcongress.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=25ba2d10590e10adb016803dc&id=2fd6e902bc&e=edbde6c9b1). More to come on that soon!
Democracy is a participatory sport y’all, stay with me!

Peter, the Artemis II astronauts are coming home today!

Personally, I can't wipe the smile off my face. When I was a teenager, I wanted to be an astronaut. I was fascinated by the idea of groundbreaking exploration and the amazing courage it takes to leave everything you know behind and reach for something bigger. **My path ended up looking very different, but that sense of wonder never really left me.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129223086/613621458/-2009658230?refcode=em26_260410_CB_fnd_gq_act___FRastro_ettx&utm_campaign=em26_260410_CB_fnd_gq_act___FRastro_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=57249279-1135-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjIyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NzI0OTI3OS0xMTM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=MiiVE1w_j6sCtAVnwskYl7wZZ58XiXtVKRy5JQDPh2Q=) To me, space exploration brings out the best of humanity, and it shows us just how much we can accomplish when we work toward a better future together.

Astronauts often talk about what it feels like to look back at Earth from space. They describe this overwhelming sense of connection and realization about how much we all share. While I never made it on the shuttle, I feel a version of that right here at home.

When I look around IA-01, I see a community I love deeply. I've raised my family here, I've built my career here, I've watched students grow into confident lawyers, and met neighbors from all walks of life who show up for each other time and time again. **There's something really special about this place and the people in it.**

Iowans are hardworking, grounded, and resilient. They're not asking for the moon and stars. They just want a fair shot to build a good life and to know that their hard work will pay off. These people are the reason I'm running for Congress, Peter.

_Early Voting Open Across Indiana_
[__](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129223220/613621959/-2139756610?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWFkMDAxYy0xMjM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EUBqlYLe0GUywEekaP9NzhQZxwuk2sC5x4dVGuycsNA=&emci=1d6c427c-0e35-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=95ad001c-1235-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4925535) Early in-person voting for the May 5 Indiana primary election opened in all 92 counties on Tuesday. We expect high turnout for a midterm primary election, so we encourage Hoosiers to vote early to skip the lines on Election Day. For a full list of early voting locations in your county, and to review the options on your ballot, please visit [indianavoters.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129223221/613621960/2120319247?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWFkMDAxYy0xMjM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EUBqlYLe0GUywEekaP9NzhQZxwuk2sC5x4dVGuycsNA=&emci=1d6c427c-0e35-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=95ad001c-1235-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4925535) today. With the primary election just weeks away, we encourage Hoosiers who plan to vote by mail to request their ballot immediately. Completed absentee ballots must be received by your County Clerk or Elections Office by 6 PM on Election Day in order to count. You can request a mail-in ballot by calling your County Clerk or online at [indianavoters.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129223222/613621961/2120319247?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWFkMDAxYy0xMjM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EUBqlYLe0GUywEekaP9NzhQZxwuk2sC5x4dVGuycsNA=&emci=1d6c427c-0e35-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=95ad001c-1235-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4925535). ****_A 17 Cent Idea From a 17 Percent Approval Rating Governor_
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129223223/613621962/598072785?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWFkMDAxYy0xMjM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EUBqlYLe0GUywEekaP9NzhQZxwuk2sC5x4dVGuycsNA=&emci=1d6c427c-0e35-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=95ad001c-1235-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4925535) On Wednesday, Mike Braun announced a 30-day suspension of the roughly 17 cents/gallon sales tax on gasoline. Days later, the average price of gas in Indiana is nearly unchanged, **and diesel is rising still – which the suspension does not apply to. ** With gas prices nearly unchanged, oil companies are not passing on the tax break to Hoosiers, they’re using this gas tax break as another corporate handout to pad their profits. **Gas prices are rapidly approaching five dollars a gallon. 17 cents is nothing to Hoosiers who are struggling to keep up with rising costs.** Braun had no problem spending $200K in taxpayer dollars on a helipad and helicopter rides from his house in Jasper, but now he pretends to be concerned about the cost of living crisis his Republican party caused. Republicans are letting oil companies use this crisis to jack up prices at the same time they screw over BP refinery workers in Northwest Indiana. It will be too easy for retailers to keep prices where they are and pocket the 17 cents per gallon as extra profit. ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks._ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/129223224/613621963/-638074818?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NWFkMDAxYy0xMjM1LWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EUBqlYLe0GUywEekaP9NzhQZxwuk2sC5x4dVGuycsNA=&emci=1d6c427c-0e35-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&emdi=95ad001c-1235-f111-8ef2-000d3a14b640&ceid=4925535) The British Petroleum lockout of over 800 steelworkers in Northwest Indiana is entering its fourth week, and U.S. Rep. Frank Mrvan is standing with the workers who are being illegally shutout by BP. His letter to the CEO of BP demands that the oil giant return to the bargaining table immediately, and act in good faith toward the workers it has locked out. Rep. Mrvan and other Hoosier Democrats have joined the workers of USW Local 7-1 in demanding an end to this illegal lockout. Approximately 1,600 Hoosier USW workers for NIPSCO were also locked out in the past two weeks, and Hoosier Democrats are standing with them and their families as they demand a fair day’s wage for a The State Party will provide the most important facts - a kernel of truth - from the week. = ** Early Voting Open Across Indiana Early in-person voting for the May 5 Indiana primary election opened in all 92 counties on Tuesday. We expect high turnout for a midterm primary election, so we encourage Hoosiers to vote early to skip the lines on Election Day. For a full list of early voting locations in your county, and to review the options on your ballot, please visit today. With the primary election just weeks away, we encourage Hoosiers who plan to vote by mail to request their ballot immediately. Completed absentee ballots must be received by your County Clerk or Elections Office by 6 PM on Election Day in order to count. You can request a mail-in ballot by calling your County Clerk or online at . A 17 Cent Idea From a 17 Percent Approval Rating Governor On Wednesday, Mike Braun announced a 30-day suspension of the roughly 17 cents/gallon sales tax on gasoline. Days later, the average price of gas in Indiana is nearly unchanged, and diesel is rising still – which the suspension does not apply to. With gas prices nearly unchanged, oil companies are not passing on the tax break to Hoosiers, they’re using this gas tax break as another corporate handout to pad their profits. Gas prices are rapidly approaching five dollars a gallon. 17 cents is nothing to Hoosiers who are struggling to keep up with rising costs. Braun had no problem spending $200K in taxpayer dollars on a helipad and helicopter rides from his house in Jasper, but now he pretends to be concerned about the cost of living crisis his Republican party caused. Republicans are letting oil companies use this crisis to jack up prices at the same time they screw over BP refinery workers in Northwest Indiana. It will be too easy for retailers to keep prices where they are and pocket the 17 cents per gallon as extra profit. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. The British Petroleum lockout of over 800 steelworkers in Northwest Indiana is entering its fourth week, and U.S. Rep. Frank Mrvan is standing with the workers who are being illegally shutout by BP. His letter to the CEO of BP demands that the oil giant return to the bargaining table immediately, and act in good faith toward the workers it has locked out. Rep. Mrvan and other Hoosier Democrats have joined the workers of USW Local 7-1 in demanding an end to this illegal lockout. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.
