There are millions of things I love about Pennsylvania

Derek, there are millions of things I love about Pennsylvania, but the three at the top of my head right now? The people. The sports. The... ice cream (Yes, really!). Believe it or not, ice cream is very important to me. Way back in the 1980s, a Pennsylvania Dairy Bar played host to a lanky ninth-grader’s first date with a girl named Lori. Before the date, that ninth grader was pretty nervous, Derek — but with a (damn good!) local dairy ice cream cone in hand, all that anxious energy melted away. You’ve probably figured it out by now, but that nervous ninth grader? That was me. And the girl he took on that date? That’s my wife, Lori, our incredible First Lady. So look, the farms and small businesses we’re investing in right now? Those are the first date spots, the family reunion spots, the weekend hangout spots that Pennsylvanians remember for the rest of their lives. [_**That’s what this election is all about. body:
We are being called to stand up for our country. Are you with me?
Peter, you and I can both see that this country is in a time of turmoil — and that we’re running out of time to set our nation back on course.

Hi team,
_The New York Times_ just published a story on what Tremont, PA thinks of the mega ICE facility coming there.
Spoiler alert! They don't want it.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0254d029-3b36-4f90-8e8b-f13cf5991212?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What they do want is answers. And they aren't getting any.
They've been blindsided and left out of the conversation about what's coming to their backyard. Now a lot of people feel powerless.
The Times quoted a local hardware store owner who said, **" We can have our little groups and we can sit and complain about it, but how much power do we actually have to stop the federal government?"**
I know I talk about these detention centers a lot. That right there is exactly why I do it.
We SHOULD have the power to stop the federal government from doing something like this. That's what our representative in Congress is for. Their job is to advocate for us. But our congressman is working against us.
**Dan Meuser has been working with DHS behind our backs to make sure this facility and the one in Berks County go through.**
This isn't about party politics. There's bipartisan opposition because the concerns here are serious local issues. Republican leaders in other states have stopped detention centers like these from being built in their districts.
Dan could do that for us - but he won't. So he needs to go.
If you feel powerless, I hope you'll join me in the fight. Because I promise you, we aren't. We can keep speaking out, we can keep the pressure on, and we can elect a representative who will actually do their job.
Sign my petition to oppose these facilities **[here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/b31bcf24-7465-4df6-9fd3-0f2fc1bdc747?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**. And chip in if you can to help me kick Dan Meuser out of Congress.

- Rachel Wallace

Shabbat Shalom, friend.
My husband, Larry, and I are about to sit down for Shabbat dinner. But before I log off, I wanted to share some thoughts that were on my mind as we celebrated the end of the Passover holiday this past week.
**During Passover, we celebrate Jewish resilience and freedom. We share the Seder meal to remind ourselves of our shared journey and struggles, reflect on how we can live a life of purpose, and renew our sense of hope. It is important we continue to embrace this as we fight to overcome the devastating damage President Trump and the GOP are inflicting right now.**
Trump's administration has already caused the cost of health care to skyrocket while cutting essential programs like Medicaid and SNAP and giving tax breaks to billionaires. Trump’s reckless tariffs have hurt our tourism industry and raised costs for middle-class families on everyday goods like groceries. Now gas prices have spiked across the country, making it even harder for hardworking Americans to get by. Senate Republicans are enabling this agenda every step of the way.

name: Jim Jordan
subject: I’ll never accuse you of abandoning us
body:
After all you’ve done for our Party, I salute you, Patriot!
| Patriot,
---
I’m sick of seeing text messages that accuse you of abandoning the GOP after all you’ve done for us.
---
All because you didn’t give $15 before some random deadline, that’s supposed to mean you **_“betrayed”_** the Republican Party and became a Democrat?
---
So all the times you stood in line to vote, you knocked on doors, you put up a yard sign, you made phone calls, you filled out surveys, you sacrificed your time and money – suddenly, all of that means nothing?
---
**_Give me a break! That’s just insulting._**
---
_Hand to God, I will never stoop to that low._
---
Truth be told, I try not to write too many emails and texts as it is. I’m busy working in Washington to do the job you asked me to do.
---
Honestly, fundraising just isn’t Priority #1.
---
At the end of 2024, I transferred $2.5 MILLION _**away**_ from my own campaign to help conservatives in tough races who _truly_ needed help.
---
**You know what I care about most?** The _ONLY_ thing that WINS elections – **_VOTES_**.
---
_That means registering voters, verifying every Trump voter’s profile, and constantly getting LIVE feedback from voters like you so that the President and I _always_ have the best, most accurate data in the country._
---

subject: Dark money just hit a new low
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
A billionaire-backed super PAC is using civil rights era imagery to suppress Black voter turnout in Virginia.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260410-1&t=1&akid=3358%2E587540%2E10ih9f)
Peter,
There’s a billionaire-backed voter suppression campaign happening in Virginia right now, and I need you to know about it.
This month, Virginia voters will decide on a redistricting referendum that would allow the state legislature to redraw congressional districts. This is a direct response to the aggressive Republican gerrymandering in Texas, North Carolina, and Missouri that is stripping Black and Latino communities of political power ahead of the midterms.
**Republicans want to stop the referendum from passing, and the way they’re going about it should make your blood boil.**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260410_1_gop.G084UL&refcode=em20260410-3358&t=2&akid=3358%2E587540%2E10ih9f)
A MAGA-linked dark money PAC bankrolled by Peter Thiel, one of Trump’s billionaire allies, has been flooding Black communities with deliberately misleading mailers exploiting images from the civil rights movement to manipulate them into voting against the referendum.
They even misused a quote from Obama — taking an old speech completely out of context to imply that he opposes the referendum.
Let that sink in.
**They’re trying to twist the legacy of the civil rights movement, of fearless freedom fighters who organized relentlessly for political power and risked their lives for the right to vote, into a tool to manipulate Black voter turnout and rig the map.**
It’s shameful, and it’s voter suppression with a fresh coat of paint.
This is exactly the fight Leaders We Deserve was built for. We need bold, audacious young leaders in office who will fight back against the billionaires and dark money groups trying to maintain their grip on power with everything we’ve got.
**[If you’re able, can you chip in $5 to help Leaders We Deserve continue backing bold fighters who will make it their business to push back against dark money groups and the lies they spread to manipulate voters? Working people deserve to have the power to determine their own future — not billionaires.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260410_1_gop.G084UL&refcode=em20260410-3358&amount=5&t=3&akid=3358%2E587540%2E10ih9f)**

Thank you,

clean_body: A billionaire-backed super PAC is using civil rights era imagery to suppress Black voter turnout in Virginia. Peter, There’s a billionaire-backed voter suppression campaign happening in Virginia right now, and I need you to know about it. This month, Virginia voters will decide on a redistricting referendum that would allow the state legislature to redraw congressional districts. This is a direct response to the aggressive Republican gerrymandering in Texas, North Carolina, and Missouri that is stripping Black and Latino communities of political power ahead of the midterms. Republicans want to stop the referendum from passing, and the way they’re going about it should make your blood boil. A MAGA-linked dark money PAC bankrolled by Peter Thiel, one of Trump’s billionaire allies, has been flooding Black communities with deliberately misleading mailers exploiting images from the civil rights movement to manipulate them into voting against the referendum. They even misused a quote from Obama — taking an old speech completely out of context to imply that he opposes the referendum. Let that sink in. They’re trying to twist the legacy of the civil rights movement, of fearless freedom fighters who organized relentlessly for political power and risked their lives for the right to vote, into a tool to manipulate Black voter turnout and rig the map. It’s shameful, and it’s voter suppression with a fresh coat of paint. This is exactly the fight Leaders We Deserve was built for. We need bold, audacious young leaders in office who will fight back against the billionaires and dark money groups trying to maintain their grip on power with everything we’ve got. Thank you, David Hogg

name: James Talarico
subject: Texas Republicans want to fine me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Talarico for Texas
body:
#
Peter —
Republicans in the Texas House are holding a hearing today to impose thousands of dollars of personal fines on me and my Democratic colleagues for breaking quorum last summer.
If you don’t remember, Texas House Democrats broke quorum in August to stop Texas’ redistricting power grab. I was proud to join my colleagues in leaving the state to stop Republican politicians from stealing five Congressional seats in the middle of the decade — outside of standard redistricting procedures.
To “punish” us, Texas Republicans are demanding we pay outrageous fines — larger than the yearly salary I get from the Texas House.
**If they want to fine me for standing up for Texans, so be it. My job is to fight for the people — no matter the cost.**
But let’s be clear: There is something deeply wrong in this state; if the majority party is trying to punish representatives for speaking up for their constituents.
They’re scared of the growing opposition in this state to their corruption, high cost of living, and broken status quo.
* They saw Taylor Rehmet win earlier this year by 14% — flipping a Texas Senate district that Trump won by 17% in 2024.
* They see battleground seats moving toward Democrats.
* They see our campaign building the momentum needed to take back this U.S. Senate seat for the first time in over 30 years.

**So they’re trying to silence our movement.**
This is why we have to take back Texas. And when we do, my promise to you is that I will always fight for the people — regardless of the consequences.

| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. | | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

| | | | High school dropout. Waffle House waitress. First woman to graduate from The Citadel. Single mom. Fighter.

Nancy Mace wasn’t born into power. She worked for every inch of ground she’s gained.

At 17, she dropped out of high school and took a job slinging hash browns at Waffle House to survive. No silver spoon. No Ivy League connections. Just grit, grace, and a whole lot of graveyard shifts.

By the grace of God, she turned that struggle into a story no politician can touch. She made history as the first woman to graduate from The Citadel, South Carolina’s legendary military college. She built her own business. She raised two kids on her own. And when the Left came for everything she believed in, she stood her ground. Now, she’s running for Governor of South Carolina.

Nancy Mace is a battle-tested conservative who’s walked through fire and come out swinging. In Congress, she’s been one of President Trump’s fiercest allies, fighting to secure our border, protect our daughters, and stop the Left’s sick agenda dead in its tracks.

She’s not here to make friends. She’s here to make history.

Nancy is fighting to:

* Eliminate South Carolina’s Income Tax—the highest in the Southeast

* Prosecute violent criminals and pedophiles with zero leniency

* Crack down on sanctuary sheriffs who let illegal aliens roam free

* Defund radical public universities that indoctrinate, not educate

* Reform education so students learn how to think—not what to think

* Work hand-in-hand with President Trump to put South Carolina FIRST

Through every hardship, Nancy never gave up. And now she’s ready to do what she’s always done: roll up her sleeves, take the heat, and lead from the front.

South Carolina is worth fighting for. And Nancy Mace is just getting started.

Team,
My name is Ryan Busse. For more than 25 years, I worked as a firearms executive who helped build one of the world’s most iconic gun companies.
When I first started, the gun industry was a different place. It was a place where people like me could still advocate for responsibility and decency.
But over time, I saw firsthand how the gun lobby changed. It gave up its values to stoke fear and extremism. The NRA entertained dangerous conspiracy theories — including attempts to undermine our democracy.
**I had enough. Now, I am working alongside GIFFORDS to hold the gun industry accountable and help save our country.**
[**Before I share more, can you make a donation to help GIFFORDS PAC continue their fight? Their mid-month fundraising deadline is rapidly approaching.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260410-1-expansion&t=2&akid=11375%2E3935704%2EJDOc6T)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260410-1-expansion&t=3&akid=11375%2E3935704%2EJDOc6T)**
Growing up on a ranch, my dad taught me to shoot at a young age. He instilled in me both a love of shooting and a deep sense of responsibility. I still shoot and hunt with my own boys any chance I get and I believe in our rights.
The way I use guns hasn’t changed. What _has_ changed is the NRA.
The NRA was founded to teach firearm safety and promote hunter education. It’s given all that up.
Now, it’s a tool for extremists to push their agenda and undermine even the most basic and common sense regulations like background checks. They spend millions of dollars every year lobbying lawmakers to bend to their will — even though a majority of gun-owning Americans support these same commonsense solutions.
This isn’t okay, and it doesn’t have to be this way.
**Since leaving the industry, I have joined forces with Gabby Giffords to continue our fight back against the radicalization of the gun lobby.**
GIFFORDS has worked to build a national coalition of grassroots supporters committed to advancing commonsense gun safety laws. And with your support, we can continue countering the NRA’s lies.
[**If you’re able, please contribute $10 or more to power GIFFORDS PAC’s work. Grassroots support makes a big difference in this work, and our fight cannot wait.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q22026.j3JysD&refcode=em260410-1-expansion&t=4&akid=11375%2E3935704%2EJDOc6T)

### **BIG WIN for Arizona as Chiricahua National Park Act PASSES THE HOUSE**
We delivered a **MAJOR******** ** win for Southern Arizona. The House passed my [**Chiricahua National Park Act** ,](https://juanciscomani.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4ed32a393c9fe1089f10fee94&id=e19308b8f7&e=659fba240e) moving us one step closer to making Chiricahua our state’s **FOURTH national park**. Leaders have been working on this for YEARS, and WE GOT IT DONE. The **“Wonderland of Rocks”** is one of the most unique places in the country. This legislation is about protecting it and making sure more people can experience what makes Southern Arizona so special. Local leaders and small businesses across Cochise County have been strong supporters of this effort because it means more visitors, more economic activity and more support for the communities that call this region home. And we’re doing it the right way by keeping local voices involved, respecting the land, and making sure conservation and growth go hand in hand. Now it moves to the Senate, where I will keep working to get it across the finish line. More wins to come.

– Juan

* * *
Vance Flies to Islamabad

VP JD Vance [departed Friday for Islamabad](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGupSAURb9GOwygiLegmMbuTTulOcLxeRI8GECd-_eTO5_wut3slZX152v5AorE37_hQOdvWkIKCxyMpb5XrBneEInrjnu6Ci5a6lHIQSi5cFxUG5wPY69bdMpaMxkrzavdnYdejRbtZvogg1WrCatFL701_QTT2pL7kOSgpFa97afObCtotSn9GiezvkwzyOsMULF0PnHBfEOlG4k5fVbizqejjW6v9SxN_6vRc6Pn53m6Lf1lfD63o9HzmSJV8qXR8w3sUTyQuQjKwGIjDiJdVdR8HafgVEViFAeWIiCni4PwCAU3yigCQhQbxFgEnJBrm104H4qRymibQX4fQPG_VP1Bx9vpfwEAAP__eZ2GOQ) to lead U.S. negotiations with Iran, warning Tehran not to "play" Washington as the two-week ceasefire shows serious strain. The Strait of Hormuz remains effectively closed despite the deal--more than 600 vessels stranded and oil prices climbing. Trump accused Iran of breaching its ceasefire promises and warned Tehran against imposing tolls on ships attempting to transit the strait. Vance is joined in Pakistan by special envoy Steve Witkoff. The thorniest remaining issues: Iran's right to enrich uranium and control of Hormuz shipping lanes. Pakistani PM Shehbaz Sharif confirmed the ceasefire [covers Lebanon as well](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckL1ygzAQhJ8GOjGS-BEUKtK4c9qUzCEd5mJxYpAM8dtnyCOk2t1id3a-r_t4BwrEj09Y0bqDRh_9CCtjyu8J8w5vCMR5wSW-Eo5a6k7IRig5chhV6a3zXa1LtMqYtm-NbIdysaavGzlPMHinQLbS18NklGuMrHvf4VCSvZZko6RWtan7qp0n0GpWeuj6dhraopGvzUPGVLnICfcDMh1IzPFykSsX1zLYJectFfVHoW-Fvp3nWc3xh_G8amuhbyt6gkvpiWJDdihO2DmJby8OuCIckbyIE6wgUn4HFLQDC48QBL9cQNhFhvBMImEWEz6IxQZPShm43K3fTgqBUmeKRj5WoPD3LP8D5mH1bwAAAP__MASHEg)--a provision Iran has already disputed. ★★★
Trade Court Tests Tariff Plan

A three-judge panel at the Court of International Trade heard arguments Friday from 24 Democratic attorneys general and two small businesses [challenging Trump's 10% global import tariff](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLESnCAURb9GOxwEES0o0tht2pTOE2F9EwQHnpL9-8zmE9Ld5p45c3691hdgwPj-Cacz9sF1T_sKZ3SFPpujDB8IGOlwR7qLWwUXI-MD6_kaw9q3u7H7KEXrTK-1mpTmam4PM40K_AySj4PSk-faymETcgTNJZcDb9F8SXzoueilllOn_Aai972Yx0lts2oGfl87kCudTbG4_ADh4zDG9F0pdjadbTAH0VUa-aMRSyOWWmvn05_o6vd2NmK5UkBCWxqxUL7Pq7DoKiPI6D27AkS2Qc4uFLaB_c1sujMxn0JIFeObnXcgLATkWIBabqQ2m_2qGAKWUTcDf5-A4Z8M_Ue_x4i_AQAA__8seILN)--his backup plan after the Supreme Court invalidated his IEEPA tariffs in February. Challengers argue that Section 122 of the Trade Act of 1974--which Trump invoked to impose the 10% duty--was written to address 1970s monetary emergencies when the dollar was redeemable for gold, not routine trade deficits. No president before Trump has used it to impose tariffs. The White House says Trump is [lawfully addressing a balance-of-payments crisis](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckD2SpTAQg08DmSnb_AcONiF7m25INaZ5dK1_KLeBebefYo4wmQJJJX3_XvMLyFF4_wWPxl40r3GdwQfk_FkwJ_iAo5B33OPJOGupOyEboeQc3KzK1di1q3WJRvV9O7S9bMdyN2D1AN26NEPXjg3KXtumX0aUdhyl1Kok8zTJRkmt6r4eqnZbQKtN6bEb2mVsi0aexwoZubIxMKYLMl1IIcRHxVDZ6Etn9pwPLuo_hZ4KPd33XW3xK-D9xHyhpyM6ymS50BOfR0KPwsYzZZEh0baJdD7vxQ4sPKT_mFmcLJaTKSAzslgS2MdB_gCby2TW4ybniLu-aOTbA7mfKfkX9C6jvwMAAP__wLWCaA). The states want the court to block the tariffs outright rather than allow them to expire under the 150-day timeline, fearing that successive executive orders will keep them in place indefinitely. ★★★
Wisconsin Rattles GOP Before Midterms

Republicans are openly reckoning with a deteriorating electoral environment after Democrats [posted historic overperformance](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckDGPhCAUhH8NdmwARbCguMZur73SIDzXlyAYQDf--4t7_-C6l7yZ-Sbz85yeFgPG17fdwLgTJ5_8ZLcIpV4z1GwvGzDWFdZ0FJgEEz1lHeVsimHijTfO961owHClpJaKyaFZDfSya73VdhbKuWFgeoEOWjX4pV20Vg2aO4l1nAneqlY_5DJbwRcuhl7LeZCkY8fubYXycCkWyKeteALGmO4rxYdLWxPMWuteSPtFxEjEePfEEO4fEWOG1xE-YiJGl45c6WxrDVCIGKXmWqiOVnuFlGnAGbIN9I3l5mGk5dgzbED_jCe6mvJFxNhk4_c3hoClV6Rjr83ih9jUfwx4GvEbAAD__whTgkg) in this week's special elections in Wisconsin, Georgia, and Waukesha. In Wisconsin, liberal Chris Taylor won a Supreme Court seat by 20 points--outperforming Biden's 2024 statewide margin by 21 points. RNC chair Michael Whatley called Wisconsin ["a wake-up call."](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLHOnDAQhJ8GOiNjjOEKF2noLm1KtJgFVmdsZC-Qe_uIPMLfTTEz-vT9eY9vIE9h_Q07WnfROMd5hD1g5u-EnOALngJvuMUz46ikMkJqUcsx-LEuZ-tm06gSbd11bd92sn2Vm22M0bgY0_Q96A4XaLTUkwYNWpplcSXZ50nqWqq66Zq-apcJVL3U6mX6dnq1hZbnMQNjrlwMGdMFTBdSCPFJMVQu7qW3G_ORi-ZXoYZCDfd9V0v8G_B-ZnuhhiN6YnK5UIOnCRP4LJjWjTGINdEhJmD2uKZ4hllkBkaRzyPhjsLFM7Hw8RYf_IqN1u0pfDAL9OgeiDLZ-bjJe8qmK7RcdyD_n4x_IPOy6l8AAAD__yc8iJw) Unnamed House Republicans told wire services they fear the environment is worse than in 2018. The RealClearPolitics generic ballot average sits at Democrats +5.7.
* * *

Pence Group Boosts OBBB Messaging

Advancing American Freedom, Mike Pence's group, launched a Capitol Hill blitz Thursday to sharpen GOP messaging on the One Big Beautiful Bill, unveiling a 90-page playbook to arm candidates on tax cuts and energy ahead of midterms. ([More](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyc0D2OpDAUBODTQGZkG8xP4GCTznrTDdGz_YAn-QdhA9tz-hFzhMm-pEql-vee30Ce4voXAmp70eySmyFEzOVjsBzwAU-xbLilM-MsuewZ75jgc_SzqJ22rm9ljVoMgxrVwNVUbxpBGWyBqwXGnoNT6FrnQEo3GSt6qEk_TbwTXIp2aMdGLQakWISc-lGZSVUdP3cHBXNjU8x4XFDoQooxPUqxsSnUXm-l7Llq_1TyVcnXfd_Nkv5HvJ9YqORrT54K2fwQo0Xm4Yx2w8zWtLOAOcNKcWXGU_liKSIztDKDcBZaTs8Mec9gQ3AskCt4hFwf2u03eU-5H6qOrwHI_8wpv3jw0vI7AAD__yDKhMg))

Patrick Warns of Texas Wipeout

Texas Lt. Gov. Dan Patrick warned Wednesday Republicans are "going to have a tough time" holding their Texas House majority in November, citing a rancorous Cornyn-Paxton Senate primary as a threat to party unity. Cooper, Brown: Senate Wild Cards

Former North Carolina Gov. Roy Cooper and Ohio challenger Sherrod Brown are the most underrated Senate candidates this cycle, per a Politico analysis, with both races carrying implications for Senate control in November. ([More](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckLGu3CAURL8Gd6wAGwMFRRp3L21K6xrurpEw1wLeWpuvj5xPeM1oitHM6Pz5Wr8g5VRev-FAH95pjRRXOAq2_tmwV_hATqXvuNN3w1UJNXMxcSnWklc5RB_iPKoBvTRGW22EdsPu7Wadc9sWrQnuiWDHpxTaonLoojF2SP5uEpMUSo5mtA_93EDJp1Rutnpzmk3i-4zQsT0ClYb1DT29MZVCt6PyCHQM2e-9n42Nv5hamFqu63qclFNPge4AU0vBqzG1HPCCv6kgU8u9zNQiplscU0vEg0KFzhsW6MgD0YmVb5WuwgvVvvMAlXIqwGlPxIWw86QnN1QfzyvlnNps2CReB6T8_1j_Acu3V_8CAAD__xg8gvw))

name: AOC
subject: "What can my one letter do?"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
There is no action that is too small.
#
One of the most important things to communicate is that **there is no action that’s too small.**
I think sometimes people talk themselves out of things because they feel like: “What can my one letter do? What can my one call to Congress do? What can my one donation or me showing up to a toy drive, or me showing up to an event _actually_ do?”
It does a lot. Because it inspires other people to show up. **It’s like each drop in the ocean thinking that it’s meaningless, when it’s actually the most powerful force on the planet.**
And that’s the key. If you’re speaking up online, that’s wonderful. How are you integrating this into your life?
That, I think, is where we start to see real change happen.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20260410.ZmL5nb&refcode=em20260410-11158-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=11158%2E2526796%2EL5AKSf)
Thank you for reading.
In solidarity,
Alexandria

name: LeftNet
subject: No president should be above the 14th Amendment
body:
Birthright citizenship shouldn’t even be up for debate.
#
Last week, the Supreme Court heard arguments on birthright citizenship, and the stakes could not be higher.
Hundreds of thousands of people, our neighbors, our classmates, our coworkers, and U.S. citizens born on American soil, are facing a retroactive threat of losing their citizenship.
This is a serious crisis, and we need you to take action now.
**[Will you add your name to our petition today to defend birthright citizenship?](https://act.leftnet.org/sign/birthright-citizenship-petition/?source=em20260410-1607&t=1&akid=1607%2E2118727%2EJevGjH)**
This shouldn’t even be up for debate. It is a core promise of this country, guaranteed by the Constitution. If you are born here, you belong here.
That’s what the 14th Amendment says, and no president is above it. _Not even Donald Trump._
But from day one, this administration has targeted birthright citizenship, trying to erase a constitutional guarantee. That’s not just wrong — it’s extremely dangerous.
**Because if a president can rewrite a core promise of the Constitution, then what stops them from rewriting our other rights next?**
**[If you agree the 14th Amendment is not up for debate, add your name right now to stand with the protection of birthright citizenship.](https://act.leftnet.org/sign/birthright-citizenship-petition/?source=em20260410-1607&t=2&akid=1607%2E2118727%2EJevGjH)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME ››](https://act.leftnet.org/sign/birthright-citizenship-petition/?source=em20260410-1607&t=3&akid=1607%2E2118727%2EJevGjH)**
Thanks for adding your name to our petition.
— LeftNet

Leyland Streiff of Maine Girl Dads joins to respond to Shenna Bellows' proposed ballot language, arguing it introduces terms not found in the underlying legislation and may confuse voters. Matt Gagnon from the Maine Policy Institute follows by describing the budget process as a series of negotiated tradeoffs, raising concerns about tax policy, revenue assumptions, and long-term fiscal impacts.

[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Yesterday, a Democratic National Committee (DNC) panel rejected a proposed
resolution to condemn AIPAC.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260410.eXLilE&refcode=em20260410-37656&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=37656%2E1203867%2EtOLz5o ]Politico headline: 'DNC avoids taking a stance on Israel, AIPAC: The
members' latest vote reflects a party establishment still grappling with
how to respond to an increasingly thorny political issue'

We can’t say we’re surprised.

In the same week the DNC refused to grow a spine, a new Pew Research
survey shows 80% of Democrats and independents hold unfavorable views of
Israel.

When you include all respondents regardless of party affiliation, that
number is still a strong majority at 60% — a 30-point increase since 2022.

This just goes to show that Democratic leadership refuses to listen to
voters and learn from their mistakes, even when our democracy and
countless lives are at stake.

The Israeli government has killed at least 72,000 Palestinians in the last
two and a half years; they continue to wage genocide in Gaza while
starting a war with Iran and conducting ethnic cleansing in Lebanon.

Voters across party lines are tired of their tax dollars being used to
fund this. But establishment Democrats in control of the party just can’t
give up those campaign checks from AIPAC and their far-right megadonors.

Justice Democrats has long led the call for the Democratic Party to reject
AIPAC, and every single one of our 2026 primary candidates refuses the
pro-Israel lobby group’s dark money.

# Navy scraps Biden-Era sub overhaul as costs near $3B!
The Navy is scrapping a **[Biden-era overhaul of the USS Boise after costs surged toward $3 billion,](https://substack.com/redirect/85ddf643-eaaf-4977-8388-b129bb91eb00?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with Secretary John Phelan saying it no longer makes financial or strategic sense.

* **Delays Span Decade** : The USS Boise last deployed in 2015, lost certification in 2016, and has been sidelined nearly a decade due to shipyard backlogs and maintenance delays.
* **Labor Shifted To New Subs** : Phelan plans to redirect shipyard labor and engineering talent from the Boise to accelerate Virginia-class and Columbia-class submarine construction.
* **ROI Comparison Made** : The overhaul cost equated to 65% the cost of a brand new Virginia-class submarine but with the possibility of only three deployments left , prompting Phelan to cut losses and move on.

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Abbott wants families to believe school vouchers are a solution
body:
Texas public schools are still underfunded, teachers are still underpaid, and parents are still being asked to do more with less.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
Greg Abbott spent years pushing vouchers as an answer for families who felt let down by the public education system. Now that applications are in, we can see what this program really is.
Nearly 275,000 people applied, and about **75% of applicants _already_ attended private school** or were homeschooled last year.
In other words, this was never about “rescuing” kids from struggling public schools. It was about using your tax dollars to subsidize families who were already paying for private education, while Abbott and his donors get to call it “choice.”
**Meanwhile, Texas neighborhood public schools are still underfunded, teachers are still underpaid, and parents are still being asked to do more with less.**
Abbott wants you to believe vouchers are the solution to this problem. But private schools can pick and choose who they accept, and they are not required to serve every student. **This program isn’t about helping Texas kids; it’s welfare for the well off.**
**The reality is that Texans want strong, well-funded neighborhood public schools — _not vouchers_.**
I ran for office because my own son’s neighborhood school was threatened with closure. I have seen what happens when politicians treat public schools as disposable, and I am not going to let Abbott drain opportunity from 5.5 million Texas public school students so he can reward wealthy families and special interests.
**[So if you’re ready to vote Greg Abbott out of office, help me stop this scam, and protect our public schools, will you chip in $5 today?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260410_2_voucher.XYZ87B&refcode=em20260410-904&amount=5&t=1&akid=904%2E299639%2Ezx0PN6)**

Thank you for being in this fight with me,
Gina Hinojosa

U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) has helped secure an additional $34 million for projects in Mobile Bay as part of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fiscal Year 2026 Work Plan.

Britt, a member of the Senate Appropriations Energy and Water Development Subcommittee, said the 60% increase in funding will help dispose of dredged materials and add more beneficial use sites in the Bay.

“It’s Alabama the Beautiful for a reason. The Mobile Bay is the gateway to our state and a hub for global commerce. I’m encouraged to see the U.S. Army Corps’ work plan recognize the need for increased funding,” said Britt. “This investment will ensure the Port of Mobile continues to grow as the premier deepwater port in the Gulf of America, while preserving the Bay’s natural resources.”

WASHINGTON, D.C., USA — U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Ala.) has joined a bipartisan effort focused on updating cybersecurity measures for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, or SNAP, EBT cards.

“Families across our nation rely on SNAP benefits to put food on the table, but bad actors are able to duplicate cards and steal benefits from the most vulnerable,” said Senator Britt. “The Enhanced Cybersecurity for SNAP Act would update SNAP card technology and protect against cybersecurity threats that undermine the true purpose of this program.”

Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) has helped secure an additional $34 million for projects in Mobile Bay as part of the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers Fiscal Year 2026 Work Plan. Britt, a member of the Senate Appropriations Energy and Water Development Subcommittee, said the 60% increase in funding will help dispose of dredged materials and add more beneficial use sites in the Bay. “It’s Alabama the Beautiful for a reason. The Mobile Bay is the gateway to our state and a hub for global commerce. I’m encouraged to see the U.S. Army Corps’ work plan recognize the need for increased funding,” said Britt. “This investment will ensure the Port of Mobile continues to grow as the premier deepwater port in the Gulf of America, while preserving the Bay’s natural resources.” | | U.S. Sen. Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) believes that Republicans have made progress in addressing the issue of the high cost of child care across the country. During a recent visit to a child care center in Montgomery Alabama, Britt spoke with providers and advocates to discuss the impact of the updated child tax credits that were passed in the Working Families Tax Cuts Act. | | WASHINGTON, D.C., USA — U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Ala.) has joined a bipartisan effort focused on updating cybersecurity measures for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, or SNAP, EBT cards. “Families across our nation rely on SNAP benefits to put food on the table, but bad actors are able to duplicate cards and steal benefits from the most vulnerable,” said Senator Britt. “The Enhanced Cybersecurity for SNAP Act would update SNAP card technology and protect against cybersecurity threats that undermine the true purpose of this program.” | | | | | | | I didn’t run for Senate to sit on the sidelines. body:
and would love your support this election season

| | Dear Friend,
I am writing today with news that I have been looking forward to sharing for some time. **I am officially running for Congress in Virginia's 10th District.**
I did not set out to run for Congress, I set out to serve. After thirty years in the Air Force, rising to the rank of Colonel, and most recently serving as Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense overseeing a $500 billion portfolio spanning space systems, nuclear defense, and national intelligence, I came home to Loudoun County. This is the place my family and I have called home since 2009. After seventeen years as your neighbor, I realized that taking this experience to Washington was the next right thing to do.
My campaign is built on three core commitments: restoring economic vitality by keeping taxes low and cutting burdensome regulations; ensuring safety and security in our communities by supporting the law enforcement officers who serve us; and bringing real fiscal responsibility to Washington by eliminating wasteful spending and combating the fraud that costs taxpayers billions every year. These are the values that Virginia families live by, and they are the values I will bring to Congress.

---
| | [Restore Economic Vitality](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
| [Ensure Safety and Security in our Communities](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
| [Push For Fiscal Responsibility in Washington](https://link.mail.beckwithforcongress.)
---
| | A campaign like this is only possible with the support of people who care about our community's future, and I am asking for yours.
There are two meaningful ways you can help:
**Donate**. Your contribution, no matter the size, will help us carry this message to every corner of the district. Every dollar makes a difference.
**Volunteer**. Join us on the ground. Make calls, knock on doors, and help build something we can all be proud of. Your time and dedication mean the world.
**Vote**. Early voting for the primary election is from June 18th - August 1st, and election is August 4th. I'd be honored to earn your vote.

I am honored to begin this journey and hopeful that you will be a part of it. Together, we can make a real difference for Virginia's 10th. oin us on the ground. Make calls, knock on doors, and help build something we can all be proud of. Your time and dedication mean the world.
With gratitude,
Dave

Here's how we save our democracy:
**DONALD TRUMP MUST BE INVESTIGATED AND HELD ACCOUNTABLE.**
Congress must use its full subpoena power to compel testimony, demand documents, and launch formal investigations of the Trump administration. That's why I've vowed to subpoena Trump when I get to Congress.
I know that holding Trump accountable won't be easy. It will take courage that most people in Washington don't have.
But I stood face-to-face with Trump's mob on January 6th, _and I 'm not afraid to stand up to him again._
#### **[I'm running for Congress to stop Trump's extreme agenda, but I can't get there without your support. So please, chip in whatever you can today before my mid-month deadline:](https://substack.com/redirect/2cc00e00-b4c1-4b03-ab17-d2ddeda83df0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Look, I'm not a tenured politician. But I _am_ a tenured public servant.
I don't have any history of being bought by this lobby or that lobby, but I do have a long history of protecting our democracy.
On January 6, I protected our democracy, our Capitol, and everyone inside of it with my own two hands.
Every day since then, I've been ringing the alarm bells. I testified in front of Congress and spoke out in Maryland to stop Trump's pardoned insurrectionists from holding prestigious government positions. I keep telling my story despite the threats.
#### **[I know what it takes to defend our freedoms with all I've got, and I'll bring that tenacity to Congress. But I need your help to win this race. If you're ready to fight back, will you donate to my campaign in Maryland's 5th District before our big mid-month deadline?](https://substack.com/redirect/2cc00e00-b4c1-4b03-ab17-d2ddeda83df0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

-- Harry Dunn

Happy Friday, Peter!

We can't build Wisconsin's future while families can't afford the present.

That’s why, this morning, I released **Badger Basics** – my comprehensive plan to lead Wisconsin forward as governor.

This governing framework is structured around three big goals:

1. **Affordability:** Lowering the cost of living by tackling the biggest squeezes — housing and energy.
2. **Care:** Building health care and child care that works before families hit crisis, not after.
3. **Opportunity:** Clearing school-to-career pathways and a clear path to a good-paying job, with stability to stay in Wisconsin and thrive
